messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM102_Ram.descript: 公羊参与羊计数、计分和繁殖。在第6/8/10/12回合结束时，你的羊会额外进行1次繁殖。每次家庭成员喂养阶段，必须喂养公羊1份食物或者获得一份乞讨卡。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM102_Ram.name: 公羊
从游戏供应区拿取食物，在你至多3个农场空格上各放置1份食物。当对应农场空格被占用时，你获得对应的食物。注：放置食物的农场空格仍视为未占用。
你可以在田地板块上如同小麦一样种植芦苇。游戏结束时，你可以将你个人供应区和田里的芦苇转化为分数，1/4/6/8+捆芦苇可转化为1/2/3/4分。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM105_RotherhamPlo: 每当你使用犁田行动格时，你可以额外犁一块田，但这两块田必须既不直角相邻也不对角相邻。仍需要满足所有田地板块相邻。每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM106_Ruins.descri: 打出时在此卡放置4个<STONE>，每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你从上获得1个<STONE>。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM106_Ruins.name: 废墟
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM107_SlapdashReno: 每当你使用了提供“翻修”行动的行动格后，在该轮次结束时，你将该家庭成员遣返回家，并在之后的轮次中再派遣他卡牌提供的翻修行动/行动格不算。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM108_Steamer.name: 蒸锅
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM109_SteelPlow.de: 限1次：在你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，可以改为犁至多4块田每次使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，只能使用1个犁/I68耙的效果。
将你已建造的1个马厩放到此卡上，你不能再建造此马厩。每当你打出次要发展卡前，你可以获得1个任意建筑资源
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM111_UndisturbedP: 计算已过的完整回合数，在接下来的这个数目的行动格上各放置1份食物，这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM112_VillageSchoo: 每轮次限1次：每当你需要支付费用时，你可以弃掉你1张手牌来少支付1个建筑资源
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM113_WildBreeding: 在每个有至少2只动物的动物积累行动格上额外放置1只该动物，如果你有饲养空间，你可以拿走至多1只新放置的动物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM114_WineCloset.d: 打出时获得1份蔬菜。每回合限1次：你可以将1份蔬菜放到未来的行动格上，如果至少是5个回合后，则额外放一个蔬菜到此格上，在这回合开始时，你必须将上面的蔬菜各转换为2份食物/1分。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_WM115_WormBait.des: 每当你使用犁田行动格时，从游戏供应区拿取2份食物放到此卡上，每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你获得此卡上的所有食物。每个丰收时节开始时，你需要退还此卡上的1份食物。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z313_StumpJumpPlou: 如果你不住在木屋，则每次你通过家庭成员执行行动获得木头时，你可以支付1份食物来犁一块田胸像
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z314_Keg.descripti: 当前回合所有玩家的所有家庭成员被派遣完毕后，你获得1个食客标记，你可以派遣该食客，并在回合结束时退还该食客使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z314_Keg.name: 木桶
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z315_BrewersCopper: 在每个喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多1份小麦转换成2份食物。游戏结束时，如果你有至少7份小麦，你获得1分
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z316_Bust.descript: 你必须在至少有一位其他玩家尚未打出他的第二张职业卡前打出此卡(3人游戏中改为第三张，2人游戏中改为第四张)
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z316_Bust.name: 胸像
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z317_FamilyPortrai: 你可以为你的每名家庭成员支付2份食物，然后你获得4分使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z318_Barbecue.desc: 打出时，你每拥有一位家庭成员，你就可以将1只动物转换成食物：羊/猪/牛每只转换成3/4/5份食物使用后请将此卡交给下家，此卡将加入他的手牌。
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z318_Barbecue.name: 烧烤派对
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z319_PumpkinSeedOi: 游戏中限3次，每回合限1次：你可以支付1份蔬菜到此卡上并获得3份食物，此卡上的蔬菜参与计分
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z320_Maypole.descr: 此卡只能在第四回合结束前打出。在你的一个空格上立直一根你供应区的栅栏。直到游戏结束，如果你自己没有弄倒过这根栅栏，则你获得2分(该格视为已使用)
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z320_Maypole.name: 五朔节花柱
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z321_Ranch.descrip: 打出此卡时，距离游戏结束每剩1个完整回合，你便可获得1分+2份食物稻草人
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z321_Ranch.name: 大农庄
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z322_DozingBull.de: 如果你有至少1只牛，则在任意时刻，你可以重新布置你的栅栏
将1份蔬菜支付到此卡上。任意时刻，你可以将该蔬菜转化为食物。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有蔬菜，则你获得2分(该蔬菜参与计分)
messages.minorImprovements.OLD_Z324_Scarecrow.des: 每当你播种时，你可以支付1根木头，然后在至多一块空田上播种2列小麦。
messages.minorImprovements.STUB_BeforeBakeGainCla: Test stub: before you bake bread, gain 1 clay.
messages.moor.specialActions.effects.black-market: Pay {fuelCost} fuel to buy 1 minor improvement
messages.moor.specialActions.effects.illicit-work: Pay {foodCost} food and {fuelCost} fuel to buy 1 major improvement
messages.moor.specialActions.title: Special Actions
messages.occupations.A085_Homekeeper.description: Exactly one clay or stone room in your house can hold an additional person if the room is adjacent to both a field and a pasture.
messages.occupations.A085_Homekeeper.name: Homekeeper
messages.occupations.A086_AnimalTamer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of just 1 animal total, you can keep any 1 animal in each room of your house.
messages.occupations.A086_AnimalTamer.name: Animal Tamer
messages.occupations.A087_Conservator.description: You can renovate your wooden house directly to stone without renovating it to clay first.
messages.occupations.A087_Conservator.name: Conservator
messages.occupations.A088_HedgeKeeper.description: Each time you take a __Build Fences__ action, you do not have to pay <WOOD> for 3 of the fences you build.
messages.occupations.A088_HedgeKeeper.name: Hedge Keeper
messages.occupations.A089_StablePlanner.descripti: Add 3, 6, and 9 to the current round. You can place 1 stable on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds (not earlier), you can build the stable at no cost.
messages.occupations.A089_StablePlanner.name: Stable Planner
messages.occupations.A090_PlowDriver.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A090_PlowDriver.name: Plow Driver
messages.occupations.A091_ShiftingCultivator.desc: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can also pay 3 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A091_ShiftingCultivator.name: Shifting Cultivator
messages.occupations.A092_AdoptiveParents.descrip: For 1 <FOOD>, you can take an action with offspring in the same round you get it. If you do, the offspring does not count as "newborn".
messages.occupations.A092_AdoptiveParents.name: Adoptive Parents
messages.occupations.A093_BedMaker.description: Each time you add rooms to your house, you can also pay 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN> to immediately get a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.occupations.A093_BedMaker.name: Bed Maker
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.description: Each time you decline an unconditional __Sow__ action on your turn, you can immediately place another person on an action space of your choice (even if it is occupied).
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.name: Lazy Sowman
messages.occupations.A094_LazySowman.rules: The additional person cannot be placed on __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__.
messages.occupations.A095_Angler.description: Each time after you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ Accumulation space while there are at most 2 <FOOD> on that space, you get a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.A095_Angler.name: Angler
messages.occupations.A096_TaskArtisan.description: When you play this card and each time a <STONE> accumulation space appears on a round space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD> and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.A096_TaskArtisan.name: Task Artisan
messages.occupations.A097_Freshman.description: Each time you get a __Bake Bread__ action, instead of taking the action, you can play an occupation without paying an occupation cost (at most once per turn).
messages.occupations.A097_Freshman.name: Freshman
messages.occupations.A098_StableArchitect.descrip: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each unfenced <STABLE> in your farmyard.
messages.occupations.A098_StableArchitect.name: Stable Architect
messages.occupations.A099_FellowGrazer.descriptio: During scoring, you get 2 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have covering at least 3 farmyard spaces.
messages.occupations.A099_FellowGrazer.name: Fellow Grazer
messages.occupations.A100_Curator.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you return at least 3 people from accumulation spaces, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A100_Curator.name: Curator
messages.occupations.A101_CookeryOutfitter.descri: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each cooking improvement you have. (Ovens are not considered cooking improvements.)
messages.occupations.A101_CookeryOutfitter.name: Cookery Outfitter
messages.occupations.A102_Grocer.description: Pile the following goods on this card (<WOOD>, <GRAIN>, <REED>, <STONE>, <VEGETABLE>, <CLAY>, <REED>, <VEGETABLE>). At any time, you can buy the top good for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A102_Grocer.name: Grocer
messages.occupations.A103_Portmonger.description: Each time you take 1/2/3+ <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>/<GRAIN>/<REED>.
messages.occupations.A103_Portmonger.name: Portmonger
messages.occupations.A104_WoodHarvester.descripti: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD>/1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> accumulation space with exactly 2 <WOOD>/at least 3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A104_WoodHarvester.name: Wood Harvester
messages.occupations.A105_BarrowPusher.descriptio: For each new field tile you get, you also get 1 <CLAY> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A105_BarrowPusher.name: Barrow Pusher
messages.occupations.A106_SlurrySpreader.descript: In the field phase of each harvest, each time you take the last <GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE> from a <FIELD>, you also get 2 <FOOD>/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A106_SlurrySpreader.name: Slurry Spreader
messages.occupations.A107_Catcher.description: Each time you place your 1st/2nd/3rd person in a round on a building resource accumulation space with exactly 5/4/3 building resources, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A107_Catcher.name: Catcher
messages.occupations.A108_MushroomCollector.descr: Immediately after each time you use a wood accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 2 <FOOD>. If you do, place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A108_MushroomCollector.name: Mushroom Collector
messages.occupations.A109_SmallTrader.description: Each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, if you play a card from your hand instead of taking a major improvement from the board, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A109_SmallTrader.name: Small Trader
messages.occupations.A110_Roughcaster.description: Each time you build at least 1 clay room or renovate your house from clay to stone, you also get 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A110_Roughcaster.name: Roughcaster
messages.occupations.A111_WallBuilder.description: Each time you build at least 1 room, you can place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A111_WallBuilder.name: Wall Builder
messages.occupations.A112_ScytheWorker.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can harvest 1 additional <GRAIN> from each of your grain fields.
messages.occupations.A112_ScytheWorker.name: Scythe Worker
messages.occupations.A113_HeresyTeacher.descripti: Each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> in each of your <FIELD> with at least 3 <GRAIN> and no <VEGETABLE>. Place the <VEGETABLE> below the <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.A113_HeresyTeacher.name: Heresy Teacher
messages.occupations.A114_SeasonalWorker.descript: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>. From round 6 on, you can choose to get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.A114_SeasonalWorker.name: Seasonal Worker
messages.occupations.A115_ChiefForester.descripti: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get a __Sow__ action for exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.A115_ChiefForester.name: Chief Forester
messages.occupations.A116_WoodCutter.description: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A116_WoodCutter.name: Wood Cutter
messages.occupations.A117_WoodCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> for each improvement in front of you.
messages.occupations.A117_WoodCarrier.name: Wood Carrier
messages.occupations.A118_Treegardener.descriptio: In the field phase of each harvest, you get 1 <WOOD> and you can buy up to 2 additional <WOOD> for 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.A118_Treegardener.name: Treegardener
messages.occupations.A119_FirewoodCollector.descr: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__, __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__, or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, at the end of that turn, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A119_FirewoodCollector.name: Firewood Collector
messages.occupations.A120_ClayHutBuilder.descript: Once you no longer live in a wooden house, place 2 <CLAY> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.A120_ClayHutBuilder.name: Clay Hut Builder
messages.occupations.A121_ClayPuncher.description: When you play this card and each time after you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space or the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.A121_ClayPuncher.name: Clay Puncher
messages.occupations.A122_PanBaker.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you also get 2 <CLAY> and 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A122_PanBaker.name: Pan Baker
messages.occupations.A123_FrameBuilder.descriptio: Each time you build a room/renovate, but only once per room/action, you can replace exactly 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> with 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A123_FrameBuilder.name: Frame Builder
messages.occupations.A124_Knapper.description: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 5 to 7, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A124_Knapper.name: Knapper
messages.occupations.A125_Priest.description: When you play this card, if you live in a clay house with exactly 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <CLAY>, 2 <REED> and 2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A125_Priest.name: Priest
messages.occupations.A126_MasterWorkman.descripti: Each time before you use an action space card on round spaces 1/2/3/4, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.A126_MasterWorkman.name: Master Workman
messages.occupations.A127_Lodger.description: This card provides room for one person, but only until the returning home phase of round 9. If, by then, there is no room elsewhere for that person, remove it from play.
messages.occupations.A127_Lodger.name: Lodger
messages.occupations.A128_RiparianBuilder.descrip: Each time another player uses the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can build a room: if you build a <CLAY>/stone room, you get a discount of 1 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.A128_RiparianBuilder.name: Riparian Builder
messages.occupations.A129_Swagman.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ or __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can use the respective other space with the same person (even if it is occupied).
messages.occupations.A129_Swagman.name: Swagman
messages.occupations.A130_MummysBoy.description: Once per round, when placing a person after your first two, you can place it on the action space with your 2nd person and use that space again, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.A130_MummysBoy.name: Mummy's Boy
messages.occupations.A131_CraftTeacher.descriptio: Each time after you build the major improvement __Joinery__, __Pottery__, and __Basketmaker's Workshop__, you can play up to 2 occupations without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.A131_CraftTeacher.name: Craft Teacher
messages.occupations.A132_Publican.description: Each time before another player takes an unconditional __Sow__ action, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A132_Publican.name: Publican
messages.occupations.A133_Braggart.description: During the scoring, you get 2/3/4/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE> for having at least 5/6/7/8/9/10 improvements in front of you.
messages.occupations.A133_Braggart.name: Braggart
messages.occupations.A134_FullFarmer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture you have holding the maximum number of animals.
messages.occupations.A134_FullFarmer.name: Full Farmer
messages.occupations.A135_AnimalReeve.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 2/3/4+ animals of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A135_AnimalReeve.name: Animal Reeve
messages.occupations.A136_DrudgeryReeve.descripti: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with 1+/2+/3+ building resources of each type gets 1/3/5 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A136_DrudgeryReeve.name: Drudgery Reeve
messages.occupations.A137_RiverineShepherd.descri: Each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can also take 1 good from the respective other accumulation space, if possible.
messages.occupations.A137_RiverineShepherd.name: Riverine Shepherd
messages.occupations.A138_Harpooner.description: Each time you use the __space:fishing|Fishing__ space you can also pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <FOOD> for each person you have, and 1 <REED>
messages.occupations.A138_Harpooner.name: Harpooner
messages.occupations.A139_HollowWarden.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get a __Major Improvement__ action to build a Fireplace. Each time you use the __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A139_HollowWarden.name: Hollow Warden
messages.occupations.A140_ShovelBearer.descriptio: Each time you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you also get a number of <FOOD> equal to the amount of <CLAY> on the respective other accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A140_ShovelBearer.name: Shovel Bearer
messages.occupations.A141_TurnipFarmer.descriptio: At the start of the returning home phase of each round, if both the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ and __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action spaces are occupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.A141_TurnipFarmer.name: Turnip Farmer
messages.occupations.A142_Cordmaker.description: Each time any player (including you) takes at least 2 <REED> from the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can choose to take 1 <GRAIN> or buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A142_Cordmaker.name: Cordmaker
messages.occupations.A143_Stonecutter.description: Every improvement, room, and renovation costs you 1 <STONE> less.
messages.occupations.A143_Stonecutter.name: Stonecutter
messages.occupations.A144_Sequestrator.descriptio: Place 3 <REED> and 4 <CLAY> on this card. The next player to have 3 pastures/5 field tiles gets the 3 <REED>/4 <CLAY> (not retroactively).
messages.occupations.A144_Sequestrator.name: Sequestrator
messages.occupations.A145_Ropemaker.description: At the end of each harvest, you get 1 <REED> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A145_Ropemaker.name: Ropemaker
messages.occupations.A146_StorehouseSteward.descr: Each time you take exactly 2/3/4/5 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <STONE>/<REED>/<CLAY>/<WOOD>. (If you take 6 or more <FOOD>, you do not get a bonus good).
messages.occupations.A146_StorehouseSteward.name: Storehouse Steward
messages.occupations.A147_AnimalDealer.descriptio: Each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__, __space:pig-market|Pig Market__, or __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you can buy 1 additional animal of the respective type for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A147_AnimalDealer.name: Animal Dealer
messages.occupations.A148_Woolgrower.description: This card can hold a number of <SHEEP> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.occupations.A148_Woolgrower.name: Woolgrower
messages.occupations.A149_HouseArtist.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you also get a __Build Rooms__ action. Each room you build during the action costs you 1 <REED> less.
messages.occupations.A149_HouseArtist.name: House Artist
messages.occupations.A150_Stagehand.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can take your choice of a __Build Fences__, __Build Stables__, or __Build Rooms__ action.
messages.occupations.A150_Stagehand.name: Stagehand
messages.occupations.A151_Minstrel.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if only one action space card on round space 1 to 4 is unoccupied, you can use that action space.
messages.occupations.A151_Minstrel.name: Minstrel
messages.occupations.A152_NightSchoolStudent.desc: Each returning home phase in which no player returns a person from a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A152_NightSchoolStudent.name: Night-School Student
messages.occupations.A153_PigOwner.description: The first time after you play this card that you have 5 <PIG> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A153_PigOwner.name: Pig Owner
messages.occupations.A154_Paymaster.description: Each time another player uses a <FOOD> accumulation space, you can give them 1 <GRAIN> from your supply to get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.A154_Paymaster.name: Paymaster
messages.occupations.A155_Conjurer.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <WOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.A155_Conjurer.name: Conjurer
messages.occupations.A156_Buyer.description: Each time another player uses a <REED>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, or <PIG> accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to get 1 good of the respective type from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A156_Buyer.name: Buyer
messages.occupations.A157_Bohemian.description: At the start of each returning home phase, if at least one __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space is unoccupied, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A157_Bohemian.name: Bohemian
messages.occupations.A158_CulinaryArtist.descript: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can exchange your choice of 1 <GRAIN>/<SHEEP>/<VEGETABLE> for 4/5/7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A158_CulinaryArtist.name: Culinary Artist
messages.occupations.A159_JoineroftheSea.descript: Each time another player uses the __space:fishing|Fishing__/__space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you can give them 1 <WOOD> to get 2 <FOOD>/3 <FOOD> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A159_JoineroftheSea.name: Joiner of the Sea
messages.occupations.A160_Lutenist.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <WOOD>. Immediately after, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A160_Lutenist.name: Lutenist
messages.occupations.A161_PatchCaretaker.descript: Each time you use an accumulation space while already having used another accumulation space for the same type of good that work phase, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.A161_PatchCaretaker.name: Patch Caretaker
messages.occupations.A162_ForestTallyman.descript: Each time both the __space:forest|Forest__ and __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you can use this card as an action space to get 2 <CLAY> and 3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A162_ForestTallyman.name: Forest Tallyman
messages.occupations.A163_BuildingExpert.descript: Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space with the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person you place, you also get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.A163_BuildingExpert.name: Building Expert
messages.occupations.A164_WoodWorker.description: Each time you take <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can exchange 1 <WOOD> for 1 <SHEEP>. Place the <WOOD> on the accumulation space.
messages.occupations.A164_WoodWorker.name: Wood Worker
messages.occupations.A165_PigBreeder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <PIG>. Your <PIG> breed at the end of round 12 (if there is room for the new <PIG>).
messages.occupations.A165_PigBreeder.name: Pig Breeder
messages.occupations.A166_Haydryer.description: Immediately before each harvest, you can buy 1 <CATTLE> for 4 <FOOD> minus 1 <FOOD> for each pasture you have. (The minimum cost is 0).
messages.occupations.A166_Haydryer.name: Haydryer
messages.occupations.A167_BreederBuyer.descriptio: Each time you build at least 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room and at least 1 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.A167_BreederBuyer.name: Breeder Buyer
messages.occupations.A168_AnimalTeacher.descripti: Immediately after each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can also buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 0/1/2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A168_AnimalTeacher.name: Animal Teacher
messages.occupations.A169_OffSiter.description: Once the total printed building cost of all the major improvements you have is at least 9 building resources, this card provides room for 1 person for the rest of the game.
messages.occupations.A169_OffSiter.name: Off-Siter
messages.occupations.A170_Hayward.description: You can build <FENCE> at any time without placing a person. (This is not considered a __Build Fences__ action.)
messages.occupations.A170_Hayward.name: Hayward
messages.occupations.A171_Sidekick.description: Immediately after each time you place a person on an action space card, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to place another person on the card immediately left to it (and so on).
messages.occupations.A171_Sidekick.name: Sidekick
messages.occupations.A172_BoatPainter.description: At the end of each work phase, if both the __space:fishing|Fishing__ and __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation spaces are occupied, you get your choice of 1 <GRAIN> or 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A172_BoatPainter.name: Boat Painter
messages.occupations.A173_ClayThief.description: Once this game, at the start of a work phase of your choice, you can turn this card face down to get all of the <CLAY> on the "Hollow" action space.
messages.occupations.A173_ClayThief.name: Clay Thief
messages.occupations.A174_MasterHora.description: Immediately before each time you place a person on an action space with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.A174_MasterHora.name: Master Hora
messages.occupations.A175_HollowGardener.descript: Each time you take at least 3 <CLAY> from the "Hollow" accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. If you take at least 6 <CLAY> from it, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> (instead of <GRAIN>).
messages.occupations.A175_HollowGardener.name: Hollow Gardener
messages.occupations.A176_Wheelmaker.description: When you play this card, if you have another occupation in play and more <WOOD> than all other players combined, you immediately get <WOOD> from the general supply until you have 15 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A176_Wheelmaker.name: Wheelmaker
messages.occupations.A177_Middleman.description: Place 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD> on all action spaces with the (meeple) symbol on the game board extension. Next time you place a person on them, you get the goods.
messages.occupations.A177_Middleman.name: Middleman
messages.occupations.A178_CarpentersBoy.descripti: Each time another player builds a room, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.A178_CarpentersBoy.name: Carpenter's Boy
messages.occupations.A179_MountainShepherd.descri: Each time you use either __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you immediately get an additional 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.A179_MountainShepherd.name: Mountain Shepherd
messages.occupations.A180_AnimalBrander.descripti: Each time you use the __space:animal-market-56|Animal Market__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the same option twice (instead of once).
messages.occupations.A180_AnimalBrander.name: Animal Brander
messages.occupations.B085_FarmHand.description: Once this game, if you have 4 <FIELD> tiles in a 2x2, you can build a <STABLE> in the center of the 2x2 during a __Build Stables__ action. This <STABLE> provides room for a person but not animals.
messages.occupations.B085_FarmHand.name: Farm Hand
messages.occupations.B086_TruffleSearcher.descrip: This card can hold a number of <PIG> equal to the number of completed feeding phases.
messages.occupations.B086_TruffleSearcher.name: Truffle Searcher
messages.occupations.B087_Cottager.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can also either build exactly 1 room or renovate your house. Either way, you have to pay the cost.
messages.occupations.B087_Cottager.name: Cottager
messages.occupations.B088_EstablishedPerson.descr: If your house has exactly 2 rooms, immediately renovate it without paying any building resources. If you do, you can immediately afterward take a __Build Fences__ action.
messages.occupations.B088_EstablishedPerson.name: Established Person
messages.occupations.B089_Groom.description: When you play this card, immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B089_Groom.name: Groom
messages.occupations.B090_CooperativePlower.descr: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ action space while the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space is occupied, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B090_CooperativePlower.name: Cooperative Plower
messages.occupations.B091_AssistantTiller.descrip: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B091_AssistantTiller.name: Assistant Tiller
messages.occupations.B092_LittleStickKnitter.desc: From Round 5 on, each time you use the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you can also take a __Family Growth with Room Only__ action.
messages.occupations.B092_LittleStickKnitter.name: Little Stick Knitter
messages.occupations.B093_Confidant.description: Place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on each of the next 2, 3, or 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD> back and your choice of a __Sow__ or __Build Fences__ action.
messages.occupations.B093_Confidant.name: Confidant
messages.occupations.B094_StockProtector.descript: Each time before you use the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you get 2 <WOOD>. Immediately after that __space:fencing|Fencing__ action, you can place another person.
messages.occupations.B094_StockProtector.name: Stock Protector
messages.occupations.B095_MasterBricklayer.descri: Each time you build a major improvement, reduce the <STONE> cost by the number of rooms you have built onto your initial house.
messages.occupations.B095_MasterBricklayer.name: Master Bricklayer
messages.occupations.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.descript: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 2 odd-numbered round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD> and, immediately afterward, a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.B096_TreeFarmJoiner.name: Tree Farm Joiner
messages.occupations.B097_Scholar.description: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>, or a minor improvement (by paying its cost).
messages.occupations.B097_Scholar.name: Scholar
messages.occupations.B098_OrganicFarmer.descripti: During the scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each pasture containing at least 1 animal while having unused capacity for at least three more animals.
messages.occupations.B098_OrganicFarmer.name: Organic Farmer
messages.occupations.B099_Tutor.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each occupation played after this one.
messages.occupations.B099_Tutor.name: Tutor
messages.occupations.B100_Clutterer.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each card played after this one that has \  in its text.
messages.occupations.B100_Clutterer.name: Clutterer
messages.occupations.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.desc: Each harvest, if any player (including you) owns the Joinery or an upgrade thereof, you can buy exactly 1 bonus <SCORE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B101_FurnitureCarpenter.name: Furniture Carpenter
messages.occupations.B102_Consultant.description: When you play this card in a 1-/2-/3-/4- player game, you immediately get 2 <GRAIN>/3 <CLAY>/2 <REED>/2 <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B102_Consultant.name: Consultant
messages.occupations.B103_FieldMerchant.descripti: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you decline a __Minor/Major Improvement__ action, you get 1 <FOOD>/<VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.B103_FieldMerchant.name: Field Merchant
messages.occupations.B104_SheepWalker.description: At any time, you can exchange 1 <SHEEP> on your farmyard for either 1 <PIG>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.B104_SheepWalker.name: Sheep Walker
messages.occupations.B105_CaseBuilder.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 good of each of the following types, if you have at least 2 of that good in your supply already: <FOOD>, <GRAIN>, <VEGETABLE>, <REED>, <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B105_CaseBuilder.name: Case Builder
messages.occupations.B106_MoralCrusader.descripti: Immediately before the start of each round, if there are goods on the remaining round spaces that are promised to you, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B106_MoralCrusader.name: Moral Crusader
messages.occupations.B107_Manservant.description: Once you live in a stone house, place 3 <FOOD> on each remaining round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B107_Manservant.name: Manservant
messages.occupations.B108_OvenFiringBoy.descripti: Each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get an additional __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.B108_OvenFiringBoy.name: Oven Firing Boy
messages.occupations.B109_PaperMaker.description: Immediately before playing each occupation after this one, you can pay 1 <WOOD> total to get 1 <FOOD> for each occupation you have in front of you.
messages.occupations.B109_PaperMaker.name: Paper Maker
messages.occupations.B110_Pavior.description: At the end of each preparation phase, if you have at least 1 <STONE> in your supply, you get 1 <FOOD>. In round 14, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.B110_Pavior.name: Pavior
messages.occupations.B111_Rustic.description: For each clay room you build, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 bonus <SCORE>. (this does not apply to stone rooms and renovated wood rooms.)
messages.occupations.B111_Rustic.name: Rustic
messages.occupations.B112_Silokeeper.description: Each time you use the action space card that has been revealed right before the most recent harvest, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B112_Silokeeper.name: Silokeeper
messages.occupations.B113_PatchCaregiver.descript: When you play this card, you can choose to buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>, or 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B113_PatchCaregiver.name: Patch Caregiver
messages.occupations.B114_Childless.description: At the start of each round, if you have at least 3 rooms but only 2 people, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 crop of your choice (<GRAIN> or <VEGETABLE>)
messages.occupations.B114_Childless.name: Childless
messages.occupations.B115_TinsmithMaster.descript: You can hold 1 additional animal in each pasture without a stable. Each time you sow in a field, you can place 1 additional crop of the respective type in that field.
messages.occupations.B115_TinsmithMaster.name: Tinsmith Master
messages.occupations.B116_Shoreforester.descripti: When you play this card and each time 1 <REED> is placed on an empty __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space in the preparation phase, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B116_Shoreforester.name: Shoreforester
messages.occupations.B117_Informant.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each work phase, if you have more <STONE> than <CLAY> in your supply, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B117_Informant.name: Informant
messages.occupations.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.descri: As long as you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each round, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B118_SmallscaleFarmer.name: Small-scale Farmer
messages.occupations.B119_Lumberjack.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Additionally, place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next round spaces, up to the number of <FENCE> you built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B119_Lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
messages.occupations.B120_Sweep.description: Each time before you use the action space above the most recent round 1-14 action space, you get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.B120_Sweep.name: Sweep
messages.occupations.B121_Geologist.description: Each time you use the __space:forest|Forest__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <CLAY>. In games with 3 or more players, this also applies to the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__.
messages.occupations.B121_Geologist.name: Geologist
messages.occupations.B122_Mineralogist.descriptio: Each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 of the other good, <STONE>/<CLAY>.
messages.occupations.B122_Mineralogist.name: Mineralogist
messages.occupations.B123_RoofBallaster.descripti: When you play this card, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to get 1 <STONE> for each room you have.
messages.occupations.B123_RoofBallaster.name: Roof Ballaster
messages.occupations.B124_Trimmer.description: In each work phase, after you enclose at least one farmyard space, you get 2 <STONE>. (Subdividing an existing pasture does not count.)
messages.occupations.B124_Trimmer.name: Trimmer
messages.occupations.B125_EstateWorker.descriptio: Place 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> in this order on the next 4 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective building resource.
messages.occupations.B125_EstateWorker.name: Estate Worker
messages.occupations.B126_Carpenter.description: Every new room only costs you 3 of the appropriate building resource and 2 <REED> (e.g. if you live in a wooden house, 3 <WOOD> and 2 <REED>).
messages.occupations.B126_Carpenter.name: Carpenter
messages.occupations.B127_Seducer.description: When you play this card in round 5 or later, you can immediately pay 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 1 <SHEEP> to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.occupations.B127_Seducer.name: Seducer
messages.occupations.B128_Plumber.description: Each time after you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you can take a __Renovation__ action, paying 2 <CLAY> or 2 <STONE> less for the renovation.
messages.occupations.B128_Plumber.name: Plumber
messages.occupations.B129_Seatmate.description: You can use the action space on round space 13 even if it is occupied by one or more people of the players to your immediate left and right.
messages.occupations.B129_Seatmate.name: Seatmate
messages.occupations.B130_FullPeasant.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ or __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use the other space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B130_FullPeasant.name: Full Peasant
messages.occupations.B131_Equipper.description: Immediately after each time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can play a minor improvement.
messages.occupations.B131_Equipper.name: Equipper
messages.occupations.B132_EstateMaster.descriptio: Once you have no unused farmyard spaces left, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <VEGETABLE> that you harvest.
messages.occupations.B132_EstateMaster.name: Estate Master
messages.occupations.B133_VillagePeasant.descript: At the start of scoring, you get a number of <VEGETABLE> equal to the smallest of the numbers of major improvements, minor improvements, and occupations you have.
messages.occupations.B133_VillagePeasant.name: Village Peasant
messages.occupations.B134_HousebookMaster.descrip: After playing this card, if you renovate to <STONE> in round 13/12/11 or before, you immediately get 1/2/3 <FOOD> and 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B134_HousebookMaster.name: Housebook Master
messages.occupations.B135_NutritionExpert.descrip: At the start of each round, you can exchange a set comprised of 1 animal of any type, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> for 5 <FOOD> and 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B135_NutritionExpert.name: Nutrition Expert
messages.occupations.B136_HouseSteward.descriptio: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most rooms gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B136_HouseSteward.name: House Steward
messages.occupations.B137_Wholesaler.description: Place 1 <VEGETABLE>, 1 <PIG>, 1 <STONE>, and 1 <CATTLE> on this card. Each time you use an action space card on round spaces 8 to 11, you get the corresponding good from this card.
messages.occupations.B137_Wholesaler.name: Wholesaler
messages.occupations.B138_ForestGuardian.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time before another player takes at least 5 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B138_ForestGuardian.name: Forest Guardian
messages.occupations.B139_ForestScientist.descrip: In the returning home phase of each round, if there is no <WOOD> left on the game board, you get 1 <FOOD>—from round 5 on, even 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B139_ForestScientist.name: Forest Scientist
messages.occupations.B140_FarmyardWorker.descript: At the end of each work phase in which you placed at least 1 good on 1 of your farmyard spaces, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B140_FarmyardWorker.name: Farmyard Worker
messages.occupations.B141_FieldCaretaker.descript: When you play this card, you can immediately exchange 0/1/3 <CLAY> for 1/2/3 <GRAIN>. This card is a <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.B141_FieldCaretaker.name: Field Caretaker
messages.occupations.B142_Greengrocer.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B142_Greengrocer.name: Greengrocer
messages.occupations.B143_ClayWarden.description: Each time another player uses the __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <CLAY>. In a 3-/4-player game, you also get 1 additional <CLAY>/<FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B143_ClayWarden.name: Clay Warden
messages.occupations.B144_Collier.description: Each time after you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>. On __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ you also get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.occupations.B144_Collier.name: Collier
messages.occupations.B145_BrushwoodCollector.desc: Each time you renovate or build a room, you can replace the required 1 or 2 <REED> with a total of 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B145_BrushwoodCollector.name: Brushwood Collector
messages.occupations.B146_Illusionist.description: Each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you can discard exactly 1 card from your hand to get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type.
messages.occupations.B146_Illusionist.name: Illusionist
messages.occupations.B147_Huntsman.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B147_Huntsman.name: Huntsman
messages.occupations.B148_PetBroker.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <SHEEP>. You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation in front of you.
messages.occupations.B148_PetBroker.name: Pet Broker
messages.occupations.B149_OpenAirFarmer.descripti: When you play this card, you remove exactly 3 <STABLE> in your supply from play to build a pasture covering 2 farmyard spaces. You only need to pay a total of 2 <WOOD> for fences
messages.occupations.B149_OpenAirFarmer.name: Open Air Farmer
messages.occupations.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.descri: Each time after you use the __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__ or __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space while the other is unoccupied, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use that other space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B150_LargeScaleFarmer.name: Large-Scale Farmer
messages.occupations.B151_LittlePeasant.descripti: You immediately get 1 <STONE>. As long as you live in a wooden house with exactly 2 rooms, actions spaces—excluding Meeting Place—are not considered occupied for you.
messages.occupations.B151_LittlePeasant.name: Little Peasant
messages.occupations.B152_JuniorArtist.descriptio: Each time after you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to use an unoccupied __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ or __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space with the same person.
messages.occupations.B152_JuniorArtist.name: Junior Artist
messages.occupations.B153_Housemaster.description: During scoring, total the base point values of your major improvements. The smallest value counts double. If the total is at least 5/7/9/11, you get 1/2/3/4 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.B153_Housemaster.name: Housemaster
messages.occupations.B154_SheepKeeper.description: You can only play this card if you have less than 7 <SHEEP>. Once this game, when you have 7 <SHEEP> on your farm, you immediately get 3 bonus points and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B154_SheepKeeper.name: Sheep Keeper
messages.occupations.B155_ArtTeacher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <REED>. Each time you pay an occupation cost, you can use <FOOD> from the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.occupations.B155_ArtTeacher.name: Art Teacher
messages.occupations.B156_StorehouseKeeper.descri: Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <CLAY> or 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B156_StorehouseKeeper.name: Storehouse Keeper
messages.occupations.B157_Salter.description: At any time, you can pay 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from your farm. If you do, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 3/5/7 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B157_Salter.name: Salter
messages.occupations.B158_DistrictManager.descrip: At the end of each work phase, if you used both the __space:forest|Forest__ and __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ accumulation spaces, you get 5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B158_DistrictManager.name: District Manager
messages.occupations.B159_LieutenantGeneral.descr: For each <FIELD> tile that another player places next to an existing <FIELD> tile, you get 1 <FOOD> from the general supply. In round 14, you get 1 <GRAIN> instead.
messages.occupations.B159_LieutenantGeneral.name: Lieutenant General
messages.occupations.B160_PubOwner.description: When you play this card and at the end of each work phase in which the __space:forest|Forest__, __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__, and __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation spaces are all occupied, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.B160_PubOwner.name: Pub Owner
messages.occupations.B161_Weakling.description: Each time it is your turn in the work phase, if there are one or more accumulation spaces with 5+ goods on them and you do not use any of them, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B161_Weakling.name: Weakling
messages.occupations.B162_ForestClearer.descripti: Each time you obtain exactly 2/3/4 <WOOD> from a <WOOD> accumulation space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and 1/0/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B162_ForestClearer.name: Forest Clearer
messages.occupations.B163_Pastor.description: Once you are the only player to live in a house with only 2 rooms, you immediately get 3 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <STONE> (only once).
messages.occupations.B163_Pastor.name: Pastor
messages.occupations.B164_SheepWhisperer.descript: Add 2, 5, 8, and 10 to the current round and place 1 <SHEEP> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B164_SheepWhisperer.name: Sheep Whisperer
messages.occupations.B165_GameProvider.descriptio: Immediately before each harvest, you can discard 1/3/4 <GRAIN> from different fields to get 1/2/3 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B165_GameProvider.name: Game Provider
messages.occupations.B166_CattleFeeder.descriptio: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also buy 1 <CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B166_CattleFeeder.name: Cattle Feeder
messages.occupations.B167_StableSergeant.descript: When you play this card, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to get 1 <SHEEP>, 1 <PIG>, and 1 <CATTLE>, but only if you can accommodate all three animals on your farm.
messages.occupations.B167_StableSergeant.name: Stable Sergeant
messages.occupations.B168_PastureMaster.descripti: Each time you renovate, you get 2 <FOOD> and 1 additional animal of the respective type in each of your pastures with <STABLE>.
messages.occupations.B168_PastureMaster.name: Pasture Master
messages.occupations.B169_LivestockSustainer.desc: For each major improvement built by the other players, you can keep 1 animal on this card (max. 8). You can keep different types here.
messages.occupations.B169_LivestockSustainer.name: Livestock Sustainer
messages.occupations.B170_CorralBuilder.descripti: When the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ and __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ action space cards are each revealed (and placed on the round space), you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 farmyard space without playing <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.B170_CorralBuilder.name: Corral Builder
messages.occupations.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.descr: This is an action space for you only. It provides a choice of __space:fencing|Fencing__, __space:house-redevelopment|House Redevelopment__, or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ if the corresponding action space is already in play.
messages.occupations.B171_GreenhouseBuilder.name: Greenhouse Builder
messages.occupations.B172_CattleCaregiver.descrip: At the start of each round, if 3/4/5+ players each have at least 1 <CATTLE>, you get 1/2/3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B172_CattleCaregiver.name: Cattle Caregiver
messages.occupations.B173_Sweeper.description: Each time you use an action space with the (meeple) symbol, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.B173_Sweeper.name: Sweeper
messages.occupations.B174_RiverbankGardener.descr: Each time you use the __space:riverbank-forest-56|Riverbank Forest__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B174_RiverbankGardener.name: Riverbank Gardener
messages.occupations.B175_FieldOverseer.descripti: Each time the other players harvest <GRAIN> from at least 3/4/6 <FIELD> combined, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.B175_FieldOverseer.name: Field Overseer
messages.occupations.B176_VillageIdiot.descriptio: The Village Idiot is your lone occupation. Each time another player uses the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.B176_VillageIdiot.name: Village Idiot
messages.occupations.B177_StoneClawer.description: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you also get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.B177_StoneClawer.name: Stone Clawer
messages.occupations.B178_TagAlong.description: Immediately after each time another player uses the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you can also place a person there to take the action as well.
messages.occupations.B178_TagAlong.name: Tag-Along
messages.occupations.B179_WildBoarHunter.descript: In the returning home phase of each round, if at least 3 <WOOD> accumulation spaces are occupied, you can pay 1 <WOOD> to get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.B179_WildBoarHunter.name: Wild Boar Hunter
messages.occupations.B180_GameTeaser.description: Each time you take 1/2/3 <FOOD> from a <FOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.B180_GameTeaser.name: Game Teaser
messages.occupations.C085_DenBuilder.description: When you live in a clay or stone house, you can pay 1 <GRAIN> and 2 <FOOD>. If you do, for the rest of the game, this card provides room for exactly one person.
messages.occupations.C085_DenBuilder.name: Den Builder
messages.occupations.C086_LivestockFeeder.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. This card can hold 1 animal of any type for each <GRAIN> in your supply.
messages.occupations.C086_LivestockFeeder.name: Livestock Feeder
messages.occupations.C087_Mason.description: Place a stone room on this card. Once you have a stone house with at least 4 rooms, at any time, you can add that room without paying any building resources.
messages.occupations.C087_Mason.name: Mason
messages.occupations.C088_CarpentersApprentice.de: Wood rooms cost you 2 <WOOD> less. Your 3rd and 4th stable each cost you 1 <WOOD> less. Your 13th to 15th fence each cost you nothing.
messages.occupations.C089_StableMaster.descriptio: When you play this card, you can immediately build exactly 1 <STABLE> for 1 <WOOD>. Exactly one of your unfenced <STABLE> can hold up to 3 animals of one type.
messages.occupations.C089_StableMaster.name: Stable Master
messages.occupations.C090_FieldWatchman.descripti: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can also plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.C090_FieldWatchman.name: Field Watchman
messages.occupations.C091_PlowHero.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space with the first person you place in a round, you can plow 1 additional <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C091_PlowHero.name: Plow Hero
messages.occupations.C092_AutumnMother.descriptio: Immediately before each harvest, if you have room in your house, you can take a __Family Growth__ action for 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C092_AutumnMother.name: Autumn Mother
Each time you use the __space:forest|Forest__ or __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.occupations.C094_StableCleaner.descripti: At any time, you can take the __Build Stables__ action without placing a person. If you do, each <STABLE> costs you 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C094_StableCleaner.name: Stable Cleaner
messages.occupations.C095_BasketWeaver.descriptio: When you play this card, immediately build the __Basketmaker's Workshop__ major improvement for 1 <STONE> and 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C095_BasketWeaver.name: Basket Weaver
messages.occupations.C096_Merchant.description: Immediately after each time you take a __Major or Minor Improvement__ or __Minor Improvement__ action, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to take the action a second time.
messages.occupations.C096_Merchant.name: Merchant
messages.occupations.C097_SeedResearcher.descript: Each time any people return from both the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ and __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action spaces, you get 2 <FOOD> and you can play 1 occupation, without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C097_SeedResearcher.name: Seed Researcher
messages.occupations.C098_CubeCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. In the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD> for 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C098_CubeCutter.name: Cube Cutter
messages.occupations.C099_GardenDesigner.descript: At the start of scoring, you can place <FOOD> in empty fields. You get 1/2/3 bonus <SCORE> for each field in which you place 1/4/7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C099_GardenDesigner.name: Garden Designer
messages.occupations.C100_Butler.description: If you play this card in round 11 or before, during scoring, you get 4 bonus <SCORE> if you then have more rooms than people.
messages.occupations.C100_Butler.name: Butler
messages.occupations.C101_StallHolder.description: Once per round, if you have 0/1/2/3/4 unfenced <STABLE> on your farm, you can exchange 2 <GRAIN> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1/2/3/4/5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C101_StallHolder.name: Stall Holder
messages.occupations.C102_TreeGuard.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you can place 4 <WOOD> from your supply on that space to get 2 <STONE>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C102_TreeGuard.name: Tree Guard
messages.occupations.C103_GreenGrocer.description: At the start of each round, you can make exactly one of the following exchanges: 1 <CATTLE> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 1 <CATTLE>; 2 <SHEEP> <ARROW> 1 <VEGETABLE>; 1 <VEGETABLE> <ARROW> 2 <SHEEP>; 2 <FOOD> <ARROW> 1 <GRAIN>; 1 <GRAIN> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.C103_GreenGrocer.name: Green Grocer
messages.occupations.C104_Collector.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it for the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th time, you get 1 <BEGGING> marker and 6/7/8/9 different good of your choice.
messages.occupations.C104_Collector.name: Collector
messages.occupations.C105_BasketCarrier.descripti: Once each harvest, you can buy 1 <WOOD>, 1 <REED>, and 1 <GRAIN> for 2 <FOOD> total.
messages.occupations.C105_BasketCarrier.name: Basket Carrier
messages.occupations.C106_PotatoHarvester.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 3 <FOOD>. For each <VEGETABLE> you get from your <FIELD> during the field phase of the harvest, you get 1 additional <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C106_PotatoHarvester.name: Potato Harvester
messages.occupations.C107_Baker.description: When you play this card and at the start of each feeding phase, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.C107_Baker.name: Baker
messages.occupations.C108_Layabout.description: When you play this card, you must skip the next harvest. (You also do not have to feed your family that harvest.)
messages.occupations.C108_Layabout.name: Layabout
messages.occupations.C109_SchnappsDistiller.descr: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> into 5 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C109_SchnappsDistiller.name: Schnapps Distiller
messages.occupations.C110_HomeBrewer.description: After the field phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <GRAIN> into your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C110_HomeBrewer.name: Home Brewer
messages.occupations.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.desc: Before the start of each round, if you have <FOOD> equal to or higher than the upcoming round number (e.g., 8+ <FOOD> before round 8), you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C111_SmallAnimalBreeder.name: Small Animal Breeder
messages.occupations.C112_Thresher.description: Immediately before each time you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__, __space:farmland|Farmland__, or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can buy 1 <GRAIN> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C112_Thresher.name: Thresher
messages.occupations.C113_WinterCaretaker.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. At the end of each harvest, you can buy exactly 1 <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C113_WinterCaretaker.name: Winter Caretaker
messages.occupations.C114_SoilScientist.descripti: Each time after you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can place 1 <STONE>/2 <CLAY> from your supply on the space to get 2 <GRAIN>/1 <VEGETABLE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.C114_SoilScientist.name: Soil Scientist
messages.occupations.C115_Sower.description: Each time you build a major improvement, place 1 <REED> from the general supply on this card. At any time, you can move the <REED> to your supply or exchange it for a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.C115_Sower.name: Sower
messages.occupations.C116_FurnitureMaker.descript: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 <WOOD> for each <FOOD> paid as occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C116_FurnitureMaker.name: Furniture Maker
messages.occupations.C117_Legworker.description: Each time you use an action space that is orthogonally adjacent to another action space occupied by one of your people, you get 1 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C117_Legworker.name: Legworker
messages.occupations.C118_WoodCollector.descripti: Place 1 <WOOD> on each of the next 5 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C118_WoodCollector.name: Wood Collector
messages.occupations.C119_SkillfulRenovator.descr: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY>. Each time after you renovate, you get a number of <WOOD> equal to the number of people you placed that round.
messages.occupations.C119_SkillfulRenovator.name: Skillful Renovator
messages.occupations.C120_AgriculturalLabourer.de: Place 8 <CLAY> on this card. For each <GRAIN> you obtain, you also get 1 <CLAY> from this card.
messages.occupations.C121_ClayKneader.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD> and 2 <CLAY>. Each time after you use __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you get 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.C121_ClayKneader.name: Clay Kneader
messages.occupations.C122_Bricklayer.description: Each improvement and each renovation cost you 1 <CLAY> less. Each room costs you 2 <CLAY> less.
messages.occupations.C122_Bricklayer.name: Bricklayer
messages.occupations.C123_Freemason.description: As long as you live in a <CLAY>/<STONE> house with exactly 2 rooms, at the start of each work phase, you get 2 <CLAY>/<STONE>.
messages.occupations.C123_Freemason.name: Freemason
messages.occupations.C124_StoneImporter.descripti: In the breeding phase of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, you can use this card to buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 2/2/3/3/4/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C124_StoneImporter.name: Stone Importer
messages.occupations.C125_Nightworker.description: Before the start of each work phase, you can place a person on an accumulation space of a building resource not in your supply. (Then proceed with the start player.)
messages.occupations.C125_Nightworker.name: Nightworker
messages.occupations.C126_Excavator.description: Each time after you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD> and <CLAY>, and you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C126_Excavator.name: Excavator
messages.occupations.C127_Lover.description: When you play this card, immediately pay an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of complete rounds left to play to take a __Family Growth Even without Room__ action.
messages.occupations.C127_Lover.name: Lover
messages.occupations.C128_WoodenHutExtender.descr: Wood rooms now cost you 1 <REED>, and additionally 5 <WOOD> through round 5, 4 <WOOD> in rounds 6 and 7, and 3 <WOOD> in round 8 and later.
messages.occupations.C128_WoodenHutExtender.name: Wooden Hut Extender
messages.occupations.C129_SecondSpouse.descriptio: You can use the __space:urgent-wish-children|Urgent Wish for Children__ action space (from round 12-13) even if it is occupied by the first person another player placed.
messages.occupations.C129_SecondSpouse.name: Second Spouse
messages.occupations.C130_OutskirtsDirector.descr: Each time you use the __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ or __space:hollow,hollow-4,hollow-56|Hollow__ accumulation space, you can place 2 <REED> from the general supply on the other space. If you do, you can immediately place another person.
messages.occupations.C130_OutskirtsDirector.name: Outskirts Director
messages.occupations.C131_PrivateTeacher.descript: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space when any __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space is occupied, you can also play an occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C131_PrivateTeacher.name: Private Teacher
messages.occupations.C132_TimberShingleMaker.desc: When you renovate to <STONE>, you can place up to 1 <WOOD> from your supply in each of your rooms. During scoring, each such <WOOD> is worth 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C132_TimberShingleMaker.name: Timber Shingle Maker
messages.occupations.C133_Soldier.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each <STONE> + <WOOD> pair in your supply. You cannot score additional points for the resources scored with this card.
messages.occupations.C133_Soldier.name: Soldier
messages.occupations.C134_CowPrince.description: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each space in your farmyard (including rooms) holding at least 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C134_CowPrince.name: Cow Prince
messages.occupations.C135_Constable.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with no negative points in any scoring line gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C135_Constable.name: Constable
messages.occupations.C136_RanchProvost.descriptio: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with a pasture of highest capacity gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C136_RanchProvost.name: Ranch Provost
messages.occupations.C137_CharcoalBurner.descript: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a <BAKE>-improvement, you get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C137_CharcoalBurner.name: Charcoal Burner
messages.occupations.C138_AnimalFeeder.descriptio: On the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you also get your choice of 1 <SHEEP> or 1 <GRAIN>. Instead of that good, you can buy 1 <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> or 1 <CATTLE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C138_AnimalFeeder.name: Animal Feeder
messages.occupations.C139_BasketmakersWife.descri: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <REED> and 1 <FOOD>. At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C139_BasketmakersWife.name: Basketmaker's Wife
messages.occupations.C140_PackagingArtist.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you get a __Minor Improvement__ action, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action instead.
messages.occupations.C140_PackagingArtist.name: Packaging Artist
messages.occupations.C141_SheepProvider.descripti: Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:sheep-market|Sheep Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C141_SheepProvider.name: Sheep Provider
messages.occupations.C142_MarketCrier.description: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can get an additional 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <VEGETABLE>. If you do, each other player gets 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C142_MarketCrier.name: Market Crier
messages.occupations.C143_StoneBuyer.description: When you play this card, you can immediately buy exactly 2 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>. From the next round on, once per round, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C143_StoneBuyer.name: Stone Buyer
messages.occupations.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.descr: Each time another player renovates, you immediately get 1 <REED> from the general supply. When you play this card in a 3-player game, you immediately get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C144_ReedRoofRenovator.name: Reed Roof Renovator
messages.occupations.C145_ForestReviewer.descript: Each time after any player (including you) uses the unoccupied __space:grove,grove-56|Grove__ or __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation space while the other of the two is occupied, you get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.C145_ForestReviewer.name: Forest Reviewer
messages.occupations.C146_WorkshopAssistant.descr: Place unique pairs of different building resources on this card, one for each improvement you have built. Each time another player renovates, you may move one such pair to your supply.
messages.occupations.C146_WorkshopAssistant.name: Workshop Assistant
messages.occupations.C147_Cowherd.description: Each time you use the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 additional <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C147_Cowherd.name: Cowherd
messages.occupations.C148_MudWallower.description: Every fourth time you use an accumulation space, you get 1 <PIG>, held by this card.
messages.occupations.C148_MudWallower.name: Mud Wallower
messages.occupations.C149_ResourceRecycler.descri: Each time another player renovates to <STONE>, if you live in a clay house, you can pay 2 <FOOD> to build a clay room at no additional cost.
messages.occupations.C149_ResourceRecycler.name: Resource Recycler
messages.occupations.C150_ParrotBreeder.descripti: On your turn, if you pay 1 <GRAIN> to the general supply, you can use the same action space (unless it is the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space) that the player to your right has just used on their turn (not retroactive).
messages.occupations.C150_ParrotBreeder.name: Parrot Breeder
messages.occupations.C151_SowingDirector.descript: Each time after another player uses the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you get a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.C151_SowingDirector.name: Sowing Director
messages.occupations.C152_Puppeteer.description: Each time another player uses the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can pay them 1 <FOOD> to immediately play an occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.C152_Puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
messages.occupations.C153_PatternMaker.descriptio: Each time another player renovates, you can exchange exactly 2 <WOOD> for 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.C153_PatternMaker.name: Pattern Maker
messages.occupations.C154_TwinResearcher.descript: Each time you use one of the two accumulation spaces for the same type of good containing exactly the same number of goods, you can also buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C154_TwinResearcher.name: Twin Researcher
messages.occupations.C155_FoodDistributor.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN> and, at the start of this returning home phase, an amount of <FOOD> equal to the number of occupied Round 1-14 action spaces.
messages.occupations.C155_FoodDistributor.name: Food Distributor
messages.occupations.C156_HoofCaregiver.descripti: Immediately add 1 <CATTLE> from the general supply to the __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__ accumulation space. Afterward, for each cattle on __space:cattle-market|Cattle Market__, you get 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C156_HoofCaregiver.name: Hoof Caregiver
messages.occupations.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.descri: Before the start of each round, if you have more building resources than all other players of at least two types, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C157_ResourceAnalyzer.name: Resource Analyzer
messages.occupations.C158_ForestCampaigner.descri: Each time before you place a person, if there are at least 8 <WOOD> total on accumulation spaces, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C158_ForestCampaigner.name: Forest Campaigner
messages.occupations.C159_FishermansFriend.descri: At the start of each round, if there is more <FOOD> on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ than on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get the difference from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C159_FishermansFriend.name: Fisherman's Friend
messages.occupations.C160_Outrider.description: Each time before you use the action space on the most recently revealed action space card (after it has been placed on the round space), you get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.C160_Outrider.name: Outrider
messages.occupations.C161_PotatoDigger.descriptio: When you play this card, if you have at least 2/4/5 unplanted <FIELD> tiles, you immediately get 1/2/3 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.C161_PotatoDigger.name: Potato Digger
messages.occupations.C162_ForestOwner.description: This card is an action space for all. If another player uses it, they get 3 <WOOD> and must give you 1 <WOOD> from the general supply. If you use it, you get 4 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.C162_ForestOwner.name: Forest Owner
messages.occupations.C163_MaterialDeliveryman.des: Each time any player (including you) takes 5/6/7/8+ goods from an accumulation space, you get 1 <WOOD>/<CLAY>/<REED>/<STONE> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.descr: Each time any player (including you) uses the __space:pig-market|Pig Market__ accumulation space, you get 1 <SHEEP> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.C164_GermanHeathKeeper.name: German Heath Keeper
messages.occupations.C165_GameCatcher.description: When you play this card, pay 1 <FOOD> for each remaining harvest to immediately get 1 <CATTLE> and 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.C165_GameCatcher.name: Game Catcher
messages.occupations.C166_CattleWhisperer.descrip: Add 5 and 8 to the current round and place 1 <CATTLE> on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C166_CattleWhisperer.name: Cattle Whisperer
messages.occupations.C167_CattleBuyer.description: Each time another player uses the __space:fencing|Fencing__ action space, you can buy exactly 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> from the general supply for 1/2/2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C167_CattleBuyer.name: Cattle Buyer
messages.occupations.C168_AnimalCatcher.descripti: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, instead of 2 <FOOD>, you can get 3 different animals from the general supply. If you do, you must pay 1 <FOOD> each harvest left to play.
messages.occupations.C168_AnimalCatcher.name: Animal Catcher
messages.occupations.C169_FastMason.description: Immediately after each time you use a <CLAY>/<STONE> accumulation space, you can renovate your house to <CLAY>/<STONE> without paying <REED>.
messages.occupations.C169_FastMason.name: Fast Mason
messages.occupations.C170_AmateurFencer.descripti: When you play this card, if you have no pastures yet, you can immediately <FENCE> exactly 1 space in your farmyard without paying <WOOD> for the <FENCE>.
messages.occupations.C170_AmateurFencer.name: Amateur Fencer
messages.occupations.C171_YoungArtist.description: In the returning home phase of each round, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to either take a __Minor Improvement__ action or to draw 2 new minor improvements.
messages.occupations.C171_YoungArtist.name: Young Artist
messages.occupations.C172_FieldCounter.descriptio: Each time another player plows a <FIELD>, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.C172_FieldCounter.name: Field Counter
messages.occupations.C173_TopOuter.description: Each time the __space:house-building-56|House Building__ action space on the game board extension is used, you get all of the <FOOD> from the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space.
messages.occupations.C173_TopOuter.name: Top-Outer
messages.occupations.C174_StoneCustodian.descript: At the end of each work phase, if 1 <STONE> accumulation space has <STONE> left, you get 1 <GRAIN> If 2 <STONE> accumulation spaces have <STONE> left, you get 1 <VEGETABLE> instead.
messages.occupations.C174_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.occupations.C175_VillageTeacher.descript: Immediately after each time you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, if this is the 1st/2nd/3rd occupied __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space that round, you get 1 <FOOD>/<GRAIN>/<VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.C175_VillageTeacher.name: Village Teacher
messages.occupations.C176_Cleanacre.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:cultivation|Cultivation__, or __space:farm-supplies-6|Farm Supplies__ action (the latter only being available with 6 players), you also get 2 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.C176_Cleanacre.name: Cleanacre
messages.occupations.C177_MountainHiker.descripti: Immediately after each time you use an accumulation space on the game board extension, you can buy 1 <STONE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C177_MountainHiker.name: Mountain Hiker
messages.occupations.C178_OnSiteReverend.descript: At the start of each harvest, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.C178_OnSiteReverend.name: On-Site Reverend
messages.occupations.C179_BovinePioneer.descripti: Each time you create at least one new pasture from unfenced farmyard spaces you get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.C179_BovinePioneer.name: Bovine Pioneer
messages.occupations.C180_Trapper.description: Each time after you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, if this is the 2nd/3rd/4th occupied <WOOD> accumulation space that round, you can buy 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.C180_Trapper.name: Trapper
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.description: As soon as you have 6 (7 in draft mode) occupations in front of you (including this one), this card provides room for one person.
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.name: Reader
messages.occupations.D085_Reader.rules: In simultaneous draft mode, the occupation threshold is fixed at 7, regardless of draft pool size.
messages.occupations.D086_SheepAgent.description: You can keep 1 <SHEEP> on this card for each occupation card in front of you (including this one), unless it is already able to hold animals.
messages.occupations.D086_SheepAgent.name: Sheep Agent
messages.occupations.D087_MasterBuilder.descripti: Once your house has at least 5 rooms, at any time, but only once this game, you can add another room at no cost.
messages.occupations.D087_MasterBuilder.name: Master Builder
messages.occupations.D088_Millwright.description: You immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you build <FENCE>, <STABLE>, and rooms, or renovate your house, you can replace up to 2 building resources of any type with 1 <GRAIN> each.
messages.occupations.D088_Millwright.name: Millwright
messages.occupations.D089_Stablehand.description: Each time you build at least 1 <FENCE>, you can also build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD> for the <STABLE>.
messages.occupations.D089_Stablehand.name: Stablehand
