messages.occupations.D090_PlowMaker.description: Each time you use the __space:farmland|Farmland__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 additional <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D090_PlowMaker.name: Plow Maker
messages.occupations.D091_Plowman.description: Add 4, 7, and 10 to the current round and place a <FIELD> tile on each corresponding round space. At the start of these rounds, you can plow the <FIELD> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D091_Plowman.name: Plowman
messages.occupations.D092_ChildOmbudsman.descript: From round 5 on, if you have room in your house, at the end of each person action, you can take a __Family Growth__ action with that person. If you do, you get 2 negative <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D092_ChildOmbudsman.name: Child Ombudsman
messages.occupations.D093_SheepInspector.descript: Once per work phase, after you complete a person action, you can pay 1 <SHEEP> and 2 <FOOD> to return another person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D093_SheepInspector.name: Sheep Inspector
messages.occupations.D094_HenpeckedHusband.descri: Each time you take a __Build Rooms__ action with the second person you place, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D094_HenpeckedHusband.name: Henpecked Husband
messages.occupations.D095_SiteManager.description: When you play this card, immediately build a major improvement. When paying its cost, you can replace up to 1 building resource of each type with 1 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.D095_SiteManager.name: Site Manager
messages.occupations.D096_Furnisher.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each time after you build at least one new room, you can build or play a number of improvements equal to the number of new rooms you built, paying up to 1 <WOOD> less for each such improvement.
messages.occupations.D096_Furnisher.name: Furnisher
messages.occupations.D097_BeggingStudent.descript: When you play this card, you must immediately take 1 <BEGGING> marker. At the start of each harvest, you can play 1 occupation without paying an occupation cost.
messages.occupations.D097_BeggingStudent.name: Begging Student
messages.occupations.D098_Transactor.description: Immediately before the final harvest at the end of round 14, you can take all the building resources that are left on the entire game board.
messages.occupations.D098_Transactor.name: Transactor
messages.occupations.D099_EarthenwarePotter.descr: If you play this card in round 4 or before, after the final harvest, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each person for which you then pay 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D099_EarthenwarePotter.name: Earthenware Potter
messages.occupations.D100_LordoftheManor.descript: During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each scoring category in which you score the maximum 4 points. (The bonus point is also awarded for 4 fenced stables.)
messages.occupations.D100_LordoftheManor.name: Lord of the Manor
messages.occupations.D101_SugarBaker.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ action space, you can buy 1 bonus <SCORE> for 1 <FOOD>. Place the <FOOD> on the action space (for the next visitor).
messages.occupations.D101_SugarBaker.name: Sugar Baker
messages.occupations.D102_SampleStableMaker.descr: At the start of each returning home phase, you can return a built stable to your supply to get 1 <WOOD>, 1 <GRAIN>, 1 <FOOD>, and a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.D102_SampleStableMaker.name: Sample Stable Maker
messages.occupations.D103_CanalBoatman.descriptio: Each time you use __space:fishing|Fishing__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to immediately place another person on this card. If you do, you get your choice of 3 <STONE> or 1 <GRAIN> plus 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.D103_CanalBoatman.name: Canal Boatman
messages.occupations.D104_Cultivator.description: For each new <FIELD> tile you get, you also get 1 <WOOD> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D104_Cultivator.name: Cultivator
messages.occupations.D105_Sculptor.description: Each time you use a <CLAY> accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>. Each time you use a <STONE> accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D105_Sculptor.name: Sculptor
messages.occupations.D106_WhiskyDistiller.descrip: At any time, you can pay 1 <GRAIN>. If you do, add 2 to the current round and place 4 <FOOD> on the corresponding round space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D106_WhiskyDistiller.name: Whisky Distiller
messages.occupations.D107_Bellfounder.description: In the returning home phase of each round, if you have at least 1 <CLAY>, you can use this card to discard all of your <CLAY> and get your choice of 3 <FOOD> or 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D107_Bellfounder.name: Bellfounder
messages.occupations.D108_StoneCarver.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <STONE> into 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D108_StoneCarver.name: Stone Carver
messages.occupations.D109_SowingMaster.descriptio: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <WOOD>. Each time after you use the __space:grain-utilization|Grain Utilization__ or __space:cultivation|Cultivation__ action space, you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D109_SowingMaster.name: Sowing Master
messages.occupations.D110_FishFarmer.description: Each time there is 1/2/3+ <FOOD> on the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, you get an additional 2 <FOOD> on the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__/ __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__/ __space:forest|Forest__ accumulation spaces.
messages.occupations.D110_FishFarmer.name: Fish Farmer
messages.occupations.D111_InteriorDecorator.descr: Each time you renovate, place 1 <FOOD> on each of the next 6 round spaces. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D111_InteriorDecorator.name: Interior Decorator
messages.occupations.D112_YoungFarmer.description: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and, afterward, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.D112_YoungFarmer.name: Young Farmer
messages.occupations.D113_FoodMerchant.descriptio: For each <GRAIN> you harvest from a <FIELD>, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3 <FOOD>. If you harvest the last <GRAIN> from a <FIELD>, the <VEGETABLE> costs you only 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D113_FoodMerchant.name: Food Merchant
messages.occupations.D114_SeedTrader.description: Place 2 <GRAIN> and 2 <VEGETABLE> on this card. You can buy them at any time. Each <GRAIN> costs 2 <FOOD>; each <VEGETABLE> costs 3 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D114_SeedTrader.name: Seed Trader
messages.occupations.D115_FodderPlanter.descripti: In the breeding phase of each harvest, for each newborn animal you get, you can sow crops in exactly 1 field.
messages.occupations.D115_FodderPlanter.name: Fodder Planter
messages.occupations.D116_TreeInspector.descripti: This card is a 1 <WOOD> accumulation space for you only. Each time the newly revealed action space card is a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you must discard all <WOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D116_TreeInspector.name: Tree Inspector
messages.occupations.D117_WoodExpert.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <WOOD>. Each improvement costs you up to 2 <WOOD> less, if you pay 1 <FOOD> instead.
messages.occupations.D117_WoodExpert.name: Wood Expert
messages.occupations.D118_Bonehead.description: When you play this card, immediately place 6 <WOOD> on it. Immediately after each time you play a card from your hand, including this one, you get 1 <WOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D118_Bonehead.name: Bonehead
messages.occupations.D119_WoodBarterer.descriptio: Each time before you use an action space with a __Build Fences__ or __Build Rooms__ action, you can choose to either get 2 <WOOD> or exchange up to 2 <WOOD> for 1 <REED> each.
messages.occupations.D119_WoodBarterer.name: Wood Barterer
messages.occupations.D120_ClayDeliveryman.descrip: Place 1 <CLAY> on each remaining space for rounds 6 to 14. At the start of these rounds, you get the <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D120_ClayDeliveryman.name: Clay Deliveryman
messages.occupations.D121_ClayPlasterer.descripti: Renovating to <CLAY> only costs you exactly 1 <CLAY> and 1 <REED>. Each clay room only costs you 3 <CLAY> and 2 <REED> to build.
messages.occupations.D121_ClayPlasterer.name: Clay Plasterer
messages.occupations.D122_ClayCarrier.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, but only once per round, you can buy 2 <CLAY> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D122_ClayCarrier.name: Clay Carrier
messages.occupations.D123_RenovationPreparer.desc: For each new <WOOD>/clay room you build, you get 2 <CLAY>/2 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.D123_RenovationPreparer.name: Renovation Preparer
messages.occupations.D124_Emissary.description: At any time, you can place a good from your supply on this card to get 1 <STONE>. You must place different goods on this card. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.occupations.D124_Emissary.name: Emissary
messages.occupations.D125_ForestTrader.descriptio: Each time you use a <WOOD> or <CLAY> accumulation space, you can also buy exactly 1 building resource. <WOOD>, <CLAY>, and <REED> cost 1 <FOOD> each; <STONE> costs 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D125_ForestTrader.name: Forest Trader
messages.occupations.D126_FieldCultivator.descrip: Pile 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <REED>, 1 <CLAY>, and 1 <WOOD> on this card. Each time you harvest a field tile, you can also take the top good from the pile.
messages.occupations.D126_FieldCultivator.name: Field Cultivator
messages.occupations.D127_HardworkingMan.descript: This card is an action space for you only. If each other player has more rooms than you, it provides the __Day Laborer__, __Build Rooms__, and __Major Improvement__ actions (all three).
messages.occupations.D127_HardworkingMan.name: Hardworking Man
messages.occupations.D128_BuildingTycoon.descript: Each time after another player builds 1 or more rooms, you can give them 1 <FOOD> to build exactly 1 room yourself. (You must pay the building cost of the room.)
messages.occupations.D128_BuildingTycoon.name: Building Tycoon
messages.occupations.D129_LumberVirtuoso.descript: Each harvest in which you have at least 5 <WOOD> in your supply, you can discard down to 5 <WOOD> to take a __Build Stables__ or __Build Wood Rooms__ action by paying the usual costs.
messages.occupations.D129_LumberVirtuoso.name: Lumber Virtuoso
messages.occupations.D130_RecreationalCarpenter.d: At the end of each work phase in which you did not use the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, you can take a __Build Rooms__ action without placing a person.
messages.occupations.D131_CraftsmanshipPromoter.d: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <STONE>. You can build any of the major improvements in the bottom row of the supply board even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.D132_HideFarmer.description: During scoring, you can pay 1 <FOOD> each for any number of unused farmyard spaces. You do not lose points for these spaces.
messages.occupations.D132_HideFarmer.name: Hide Farmer
messages.occupations.D133_BeerTentOperator.descri: In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can use this card to turn 1 <WOOD> plus 1 <GRAIN> into 1 bonus <SCORE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D133_BeerTentOperator.name: Beer Tent Operator
messages.occupations.D134_OysterEater.description: Each time the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space is used, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> and must skip placing your next person that round. (You can place the person on a later turn.)
messages.occupations.D134_OysterEater.name: Oyster Eater
messages.occupations.D135_GardeningHeadOfficial.d: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most <VEGETABLE> in their <FIELD> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D136_AnimalActivist.descript: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most fenced <STABLE> gets 2 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D136_AnimalActivist.name: Animal Activist
messages.occupations.D137_TradeTeacher.descriptio: Each time after you use a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you can buy up to 2 different goods: <GRAIN>, <STONE>, <SHEEP>, and <PIG> for 1 <FOOD> each; <CATTLE> and <VEGETABLE> for 2 <FOOD> each.
messages.occupations.D137_TradeTeacher.name: Trade Teacher
messages.occupations.D138_PetLover.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing exactly 1 animal, you can leave it on the space and get one from the general supply instead, as well as 3 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D138_PetLover.name: Pet Lover
messages.occupations.D139_Chairman.description: Each time another player uses the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space, both they and you get 1 <FOOD> (before taking the actions). If you use it, you get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D139_Chairman.name: Chairman
messages.occupations.D140_Loudmouth.description: Each time you take at least 4 building resources or 4 animals from an accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D140_Loudmouth.name: Loudmouth
messages.occupations.D141_SeedSeller.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you get 1 additional <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D141_SeedSeller.name: Seed Seller
messages.occupations.D142_PotatoPlanter.descripti: At the end of each work phase in which you occupy the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ or __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space while the respective other is unoccupied, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.D142_PotatoPlanter.name: Potato Planter
messages.occupations.D143_TreeCutter.description: Each time you use an accumulation space providing at least 3 goods of the same type except <WOOD>, you get an additional 1 <WOOD>. (<FOOD> is also considered a good.)
messages.occupations.D143_TreeCutter.name: Tree Cutter
messages.occupations.D144_WaterWorker.description: Each time after you use any of the __space:fishing|Fishing__, __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__, __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ spaces or the action space of round 4, you get 1 additional <REED>.
messages.occupations.D144_WaterWorker.name: Water Worker
messages.occupations.D145_RoofExaminer.descriptio: When you play this card, if you have 1/2/3/4 major improvements, you immediately get 2/3/4/5 <REED>.
messages.occupations.D145_RoofExaminer.name: Roof Examiner
messages.occupations.D146_Porter.description: Each time you take at least 4 of the same building resource from an accumulation space, you get 1 additional building resource of the accumulating type and 1 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.D146_Porter.name: Porter
messages.occupations.D147_TrapBuilder.description: Each time you use the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, place 1 <FOOD>, 1 <FOOD>, and 1 <PIG> on the next 3 round spaces, respectively. At the start of these rounds, you get the good.
messages.occupations.D147_TrapBuilder.name: Trap Builder
messages.occupations.D148_DomesticianExpert.descr: You can keep 2 <SHEEP> on the border between each pair of orthogonally adjacent rooms.
messages.occupations.D148_DomesticianExpert.name: Domestician Expert
messages.occupations.D149_CasualWorker.descriptio: Each time another player uses a __space:western-quarry,eastern-quarry|Quarry__ accumulation space, you can choose to get 1 <FOOD> or build a <STABLE> without paying <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.D149_CasualWorker.name: Casual Worker
messages.occupations.D150_GodlySpouse.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action with the second person you place in a round, return the first person you placed home, unless it is on the __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ action space.
messages.occupations.D150_GodlySpouse.name: Godly Spouse
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.description: Immediately after each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can place another person on an action space of your choice, regardless whether or not the action space is occupied.
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.name: Spin Doctor
messages.occupations.D151_SpinDoctor.rules: No card, including this one, can allow you to use __space:meeting-place|Meeting Place__ if it is already occupied.
messages.occupations.D152_Patron.description: Immediately before each time you play an occupation after this one (even before paying the occupation cost), you get 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D152_Patron.name: Patron
messages.occupations.D153_WealthyMan.description: At the start of each of the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th/6th harvest, if you have at least 1/2/3/4/5/6 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D153_WealthyMan.name: Wealthy Man
messages.occupations.D154_ChimneySweep.descriptio: Renovating to <STONE> costs you 2 <STONE> less. During scoring, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each other player living in a stone house.
messages.occupations.D154_ChimneySweep.name: Chimney Sweep
messages.occupations.D155_Ebonist.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to turn exactly 1 <WOOD> into 1 <FOOD> and 1 <GRAIN>.
messages.occupations.D155_Ebonist.name: Ebonist
messages.occupations.D156_RetailDealer.descriptio: Place 3 <GRAIN> and 3 <FOOD> on this card. Each time you use the __space:resource-market,resource-market-4,resource-market-56,moor-resource-market-12|Resource Market__ action space, you also get 1 <GRAIN> and 1 <FOOD> from this card.
messages.occupations.D156_RetailDealer.name: Retail Dealer
messages.occupations.D157_PartyOrganizer.descript: As soon as the next player but you gains their 5th person, you immediately get 8 <FOOD> (not retroactively). During scoring, if only you have 5 people, you get 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.D157_PartyOrganizer.name: Party Organizer
messages.occupations.D158_BeanCounter.description: Each time you use an action space on round spaces 1 to 8, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Each time this cards has 3 <FOOD> on it, move the <FOOD> to your supply.
messages.occupations.D158_BeanCounter.name: Bean Counter
messages.occupations.D159_ReedSeller.description: At any time, you can turn 1 <REED> into 3 <FOOD>. Any other player can prevent this by buying the <REED> for 2 <FOOD> from you. If multiple players are interested, choose one.
messages.occupations.D159_ReedSeller.name: Reed Seller
messages.occupations.D160_Midwife.description: Each time another player uses the first person they place in a round to take a __Family Growth__ action, you get 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply.
messages.occupations.D160_Midwife.name: Midwife
messages.occupations.D161_CabbageBuyer.descriptio: Each time any player (including you) renovates and then builds no/1 minor/1 major improvement, you can buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 3/2/1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D161_CabbageBuyer.name: Cabbage Buyer
messages.occupations.D162_ClayFirer.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <CLAY>. At any time, you can turn <CLAY> into <STONE>: you get 1 <STONE> for 2 <CLAY>, and 2 <STONE> for 3 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.D162_ClayFirer.name: Clay Firer
messages.occupations.D163_JourneymanBricklayer.de: When you play this card, you immediately get 2 <STONE>. Each time another player renovates to <STONE> or builds a stone room, you get 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.D164_PetGrower.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, if afterward you have no animal in your house, you also get 1 <SHEEP>.
messages.occupations.D164_PetGrower.name: Pet Grower
messages.occupations.D165_PigStalker.description: Each time you use an animal accumulation space, you get an additional 1 <PIG> if you occupy a Round 1-14 action space which is immediately to the left or right of that accumulation space.
messages.occupations.D165_PigStalker.name: Pig Stalker
messages.occupations.D166_StableMilker.descriptio: Each time you build at least 2 <STABLE> on the same turn, you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.D166_StableMilker.name: Stable Milker
messages.occupations.D167_PureBreeder.description: You immediately get 1 <WOOD>. After each round that does not end with a harvest, you can breed exactly one type of animal. (This is not considered a breeding phase.)
messages.occupations.D167_PureBreeder.name: Pure Breeder
messages.occupations.D168_Stockman.description: When you build your 2nd/3rd/4th <STABLE>, you immediately get 1 <CATTLE>/<PIG>/<SHEEP>, even if built on the same turn (but not retroactively).
messages.occupations.D168_Stockman.name: Stockman
messages.occupations.D169_Plowsmith.description: Each time another player takes at least 4 <WOOD> from an accumulation space, you can immediately pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D169_Plowsmith.name: Plowsmith
messages.occupations.D170_FoldBuilder.description: This card is an action space for all. It provides a __Build Fences__ action and then 1 <SHEEP>. If another player uses it, they must first pay you 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D170_FoldBuilder.name: Fold Builder
messages.occupations.D171_SeniorTeacher.descripti: Each time another player pays <FOOD> on a __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action space, you get exactly 1 of that <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D171_SeniorTeacher.name: Senior Teacher
messages.occupations.D172_PutcherMaker.descriptio: At any time, you can exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D172_PutcherMaker.name: Putcher Maker
messages.occupations.D173_TownClerk.description: Each time a major improvement is built, place 1 <FOOD> on this card. Once this game, you can turn this card face down to get the <FOOD> on it.
messages.occupations.D173_TownClerk.name: Town Clerk
messages.occupations.D174_LoessGardener.descripti: Each time you use the __space:clay-pit|Clay Pit__ accumulation space, you can also buy 1 <VEGETABLE> for 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D174_LoessGardener.name: Loess Gardener
messages.occupations.D175_Countryman.description: Each time any player (including you) takes a __Renovation__ action on an action space, you can sow crops in exactly 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.D175_Countryman.name: Countryman
messages.occupations.D176_Woodshacker.description: In the work phase of each round, the first and the second time you use a <WOOD> accumulation space, you also get 1 and 2 <CLAY> respectively.
messages.occupations.D176_Woodshacker.name: Woodshacker
messages.occupations.D177_Graduate.description: When you play this card you immediately pay 1 <FOOD>. If you do, you get 2 <STONE> and 2 <REED>.
messages.occupations.D177_Graduate.name: Graduate
messages.occupations.D178_SubstituteTeacher.descr: Each time all three __space:lessons,lessons-3,lessons-4,lessons-56-2f,lessons-56-variable|Lessons__ action spaces are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get your choice of 1 building resource or 1 crop of each type.
messages.occupations.D178_SubstituteTeacher.name: Substitute Teacher
messages.occupations.D179_Bullcatcher.description: When both action spaces on round spaces 3 and 6 are occupied, you can use this card with a person to get 1 <CATTLE> and 2 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.D179_Bullcatcher.name: Bullcatcher
messages.occupations.D180_PartTimeWorker.descript: Each time you use an accumulation space with exactly 2/4/6 goods on it, you can leave 1/2/3 goods on the space. If you do, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.D180_PartTimeWorker.name: Part-Time Worker
messages.occupations.E085_MasterTanner.descriptio: For each <PIG> or <CATTLE> you turn into <FOOD>, you can place 1 of that <FOOD> on this card. While its <FOOD> equals your number of rooms, this card provides room for 1 person.
messages.occupations.E085_MasterTanner.name: Master Tanner
messages.occupations.E086_PenBuilder.description: At any time, you can discard 1 <WOOD> from your supply. This card can hold two animals of any type for each <WOOD> discarded this way.
messages.occupations.E086_PenBuilder.name: Pen Builder
messages.occupations.E087_MasterRenovator.descrip: At the end of the work phases of rounds 7 and 9, you can take a __Renovation__ action without placing a person and pay 1 building resource of your choice less.
messages.occupations.E087_MasterRenovator.name: Master Renovator
messages.occupations.E088_MasterFencer.descriptio: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you can pay 2 or 3 <WOOD> to build up to 3 or 4 <FENCE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E088_MasterFencer.name: Master Fencer
messages.occupations.E089_Stallwright.description: After you play your 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 7th occupation (including this one), you can build 1 <STABLE> at no cost.
messages.occupations.E089_Stallwright.name: Stallwright
messages.occupations.E090_DungCollector.descripti: Each time you get 2 or more newborn animals, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.occupations.E090_DungCollector.name: Dung Collector
messages.occupations.E091_PlowBuilder.description: You can build the Joinery when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action. If you use the Joinery (or an upgrade thereof) during the harvest, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 field.
messages.occupations.E091_PlowBuilder.name: Plow Builder
messages.occupations.E092_FieldDoctor.description: Once this game, if you live in a house with exactly 2 rooms surrounded by 4 field tiles, you can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.occupations.E092_FieldDoctor.name: Field Doctor
messages.occupations.E093_Motivator.description: On your first turn each round, if you have no unused farmyard spaces, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.occupations.E093_Motivator.name: Motivator
messages.occupations.E094_Prophet.description: When you play this card, immediately take a __Renovation__ action. Afterward, you can take a __Build Fences__ action. (Both actions require their usual cost.)
messages.occupations.E094_Prophet.name: Prophet
messages.occupations.E095_Miller.description: You can immediately build a <BAKE>-improvement by paying its cost. Each time another player uses the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action.
messages.occupations.E095_Miller.name: Miller
messages.occupations.E096_Elder.description: You can play this card at the start of the work phase of round 1 without placing a person. (This card has no effect other than counting as a played occupation.)
messages.occupations.E096_Elder.name: Elder
messages.occupations.E097_Beneficiary.description: If this is your 3rd occupation, you can immediately play another occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD> and/or play 1 minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E097_Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
messages.occupations.E098_Prodigy.description: If this is your 1st occupation, you immediately get 1 <SCORE> for each improvement you have. (This will not apply to improvements played after this card.)
messages.occupations.E098_Prodigy.name: Prodigy
messages.occupations.E099_UncaringParents.descrip: At the end of each harvest, if you live in a stone house, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E099_UncaringParents.name: Uncaring Parents
messages.occupations.E100_MuseumCaretaker.descrip: At the start of each work phase, if you have at least 1 <WOOD>, 1 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, 1 <STONE>, 1 <GRAIN>, and 1 <VEGETABLE> in your supply, you get 1 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E100_MuseumCaretaker.name: Museum Caretaker
messages.occupations.E101_Blighter.description: When you play this card, you get 1 bonus <SCORE> for each complete stage left to play. You may not play any more occupations.
messages.occupations.E101_Blighter.name: Blighter
messages.occupations.E102_Acquirer.description: At the start of each round, you can pay <FOOD> equal to the number of people you have to buy 1 good of your choice from the general supply.
messages.occupations.E102_Acquirer.name: Acquirer
messages.occupations.E103_Wolf.description: Pile (from bottom to top) 1 <CLAY>, 1 <WOOD>, and 1 <GRAIN> on this card. Each time you get a good matching the top item, you can move that item to your supply and get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.E103_Wolf.name: Wolf
messages.occupations.E104_SpiceTrader.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 3 <VEGETABLE> on the space for round 11. At the start of that round, you get the <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E104_SpiceTrader.name: Spice Trader
messages.occupations.E105_Pioneer.description: When you play this card and each time before you use the most recent action space card, you get 1 building resource of your choice and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E105_Pioneer.name: Pioneer
messages.occupations.E106_EmergencySeller.descrip:
When you play this card, you can immediately turn as many building resources into <FOOD> as you have people:
<WOOD>/<CLAY> <ARROW> 2 <FOOD>
<REED>/<STONE> <ARROW> 3 <FOOD>
messages.occupations.E106_EmergencySeller.name: Emergency Seller
messages.occupations.E107_LandSurveyor.descriptio: In the field phase of each harvest, if you have at least 2/4/6/7 <FIELD>, you get 1/2/3/4 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E107_LandSurveyor.name: Land Surveyor
messages.occupations.E108_BlackberryFarmer.descri: Each time you build <FENCE>, place 1 <FOOD> on each remaining round space, up to the number of <FENCE> just built. At the start of these rounds, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E108_BlackberryFarmer.name: Blackberry Farmer
messages.occupations.E109_BraidMaker.description: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange 1 <REED> for 2 <FOOD>. You can build the  __Basketmaker\\
messages.occupations.E109_BraidMaker.name: Braid Maker
messages.occupations.E110_Dentist.description: At the start of each harvest, you can place 1 <WOOD> from your supply on this card, irretrievably. In each feeding phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <WOOD> on this card.
messages.occupations.E110_Dentist.name: Dentist
messages.occupations.E111_Recluse.description: As long as you have no minor improvements in front of you, you get 1 <FOOD> at the start of each round and 1 <WOOD> at the start of each harvest.
messages.occupations.E111_Recluse.name: Recluse
messages.occupations.E112_GrainThief.description: Each time you would harvest a grain field, you can leave the grain on the field and take 1 <GRAIN> from the general supply instead.
messages.occupations.E112_GrainThief.name: Grain Thief
messages.occupations.E113_Godmother.description: Each time you take a __Family Growth__ action, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E113_Godmother.name: Godmother
messages.occupations.E114_ShedBuilder.description: When you build your 1st and 2nd <STABLE>, you get 1 <GRAIN>. When you build your 3rd and 4th <STABLE>, you get 1 <VEGETABLE>. (This does not apply to <STABLE> you have already built.)
messages.occupations.E114_ShedBuilder.name: Shed Builder
messages.occupations.E115_SeedServant.description: Each time after you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Bake Bread__ action. Each time after you use the __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you can take a __Sow__ action.
messages.occupations.E115_SeedServant.name: Seed Servant
messages.occupations.E116_FirCutter.description: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 <FOOD>. Each time after you use an animal accumulation space with your 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/5th person, you get 1/1/2/2/3 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E116_FirCutter.name: Fir Cutter
messages.occupations.E117_PipeSmoker.description: At the start of each harvest, if you have at least 1 <GRAIN> <FIELD>, you get 2 <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E117_PipeSmoker.name: Pipe Smoker
messages.occupations.E118_KindlingGatherer.descri: Each time you get <FOOD> from an action space, you get 1 additional <WOOD>.
messages.occupations.E118_KindlingGatherer.name: Kindling Gatherer
messages.occupations.E119_LandHeir.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, place 4 <WOOD> and 4 <CLAY> on the space for round 9. At the start of this round, you get the resources.
messages.occupations.E119_LandHeir.name: Land Heir
messages.occupations.E120_ScrapCollector.descript: Alternate placing 1 <WOOD> and 1 <CLAY> on each of the next 6 round spaces, starting with <WOOD>. At the start of these rounds, you get the respective resource.
messages.occupations.E120_ScrapCollector.name: Scrap Collector
messages.occupations.E121_HillCultivator.descript: Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 2 or 3 <CLAY>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E121_HillCultivator.name: Hill Cultivator
messages.occupations.E122_Cottar.description: Each time you play or build an improvement, you get your choice of 1 <WOOD> or 1 <CLAY> immediately after paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E122_Cottar.name: Cottar
messages.occupations.E123_ResourceHoarder.descrip: Pile resources as depicted on this card. You can use the top item(s) when building a room, playing/building an improvement, or renovating. (From bottom to top: <STONE>, <CLAY>, <STONE>, <REED>, <WOOD>, <CLAY>)
messages.occupations.E123_ResourceHoarder.name: Resource Hoarder
messages.occupations.E124_MayorCandidate.descript: You immediately get 2 <WOOD> and 2 <STONE>. During scoring, you get 1 negative point for each <WOOD> and each <STONE> in your supply. You can no longer discard <WOOD> or <STONE>.
messages.occupations.E124_MayorCandidate.name: Mayor Candidate
messages.occupations.E125_DelayedWayfarer.descrip: When you play this card, you immediately get 1 building resource of your choice and, once all people have been placed this round, you can place a person from your supply.
messages.occupations.E125_DelayedWayfarer.name: Delayed Wayfarer
messages.occupations.E126_TaxCollector.descriptio: Once you live in a stone house, at the start of each round, you get your choice of 2 <WOOD>, 2 <CLAY>, 1 <REED>, or 1 <STONE>.
messages.occupations.E126_TaxCollector.name: Tax Collector
messages.occupations.E127_DiligentFarmer.descript: When you play this card, if you would score the maximum 4 points in 3 scoring categories (including fenced <STABLE>), you can extend your house by 1 room at no cost.
messages.occupations.E127_DiligentFarmer.name: Diligent Farmer
messages.occupations.E128_Saddler.description: Each time after you build a major improvement, you can pay 1 <FOOD> to plow 1 <FIELD>.
messages.occupations.E128_Saddler.name: Saddler
messages.occupations.E129_Imitator.description: If you have a person on the __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__ action space, you can use non-accumulating round 1-9 action spaces even if they are occupied.
messages.occupations.E129_Imitator.name: Imitator
messages.occupations.E130_Overachiever.descriptio: Each time you use a __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space, you can play 1 additional improvement by paying its cost minus 1 resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.E130_Overachiever.name: Overachiever
messages.occupations.E131_MarketMaster.descriptio: Immediately after each time you place your last person in a round on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space, you can play 1 occupation for an occupation cost of 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E131_MarketMaster.name: Market Master
messages.occupations.E132_VeggieLover.name: Veggie Lover
messages.occupations.E133_ChampionBreeder.descrip: Each time you place 2 or 3+ newborn animals on your farm during the breeding phase of the harvest, you get 1 or 2 bonus <SCORE>, respectively.
messages.occupations.E133_ChampionBreeder.name: Champion Breeder
messages.occupations.E134_Omnifarmer.description: Each harvest, you can place 1 harvested crop or 1 newborn animal on this card, irretrievably. Once this game, if there are 2/3/4/5 different goods on this, you get 3/5/7/9 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E134_Omnifarmer.name: Omnifarmer
messages.occupations.E135_Pickler.description: If there are still 1/3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 1/2/3/4 <WOOD>. During scoring, each player with the most total <VEGETABLE> gets 3 bonus <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E135_Pickler.name: Pickler
messages.occupations.E136_AnimalHusbandryWorker.d: If there are still 3/6/9 complete rounds left to play, you immediately get 2/3/4 <WOOD> and a __Build Fences__ action. During scoring, each player with the most pastures gets 2 <SCORE>.
messages.occupations.E137_FlaxFarmer.description: Each time you use the __space:reed-bank|Reed Bank__ accumulation space, you also get 1 <GRAIN>. Each time you use the __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.E137_FlaxFarmer.name: Flax Farmer
messages.occupations.E138_LivestockExpert.descrip: If you play this card in round 11 or before, choose an animal type: you immediately get a number of animals of that type equal to the number you already have on your farm.
messages.occupations.E138_LivestockExpert.name: Livestock Expert
messages.occupations.E139_BunnyBreeder.descriptio: Select a future round space, subtract the number of the current round from it, and place this many <FOOD> on that space. At the start of that round, you get the <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E139_BunnyBreeder.name: Bunny Breeder
messages.occupations.E140_Carter.description: Next round, each time you use a building resource accumulation space, you also get 1 <FOOD> for each building resource that you take from the space.
messages.occupations.E140_Carter.name: Carter
messages.occupations.E141_VegetableVendor.descrip: Each time you use the __space:major-improvement|Major Improvement__ or __space:vegetable-seeds|Vegetable Seeds__ action space, you also get 1 <VEGETABLE> or a __Major or Minor Improvement__ action, respectively.
messages.occupations.E141_VegetableVendor.name: Vegetable Vendor
messages.occupations.E142_Smuggler.description:
In the feeding phase of each harvest, you can exchange up to 2 goods as follows:
[<WOOD> <ARROW> <GRAIN>]
or
[<GRAIN> <ARROW> <STONE>]
messages.occupations.E142_Smuggler.name: Smuggler
messages.occupations.E143_Hewer.description: From round 3 on, at the end of each work phase in which all <CLAY> accumulation spaces are unoccupied, you get 1 <STONE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E143_Hewer.name: Hewer
messages.occupations.E144_WaresSalesman.descripti: Each time any player (including you) plays or builds a card that lets them turn building resources into <FOOD>, you get exactly 1 corresponding building resource and 1 <REED>.
messages.occupations.E144_WaresSalesman.name: Wares Salesman
messages.occupations.E145_Parvenu.description: If you play this card in round 7 or before, choose <CLAY> or <REED>: you immediately get a number of that building resource equal to the number you already have in your supply.
messages.occupations.E145_Parvenu.name: Parvenu
messages.occupations.E146_Reseller.description: Once this game, immediately after playing or building an improvement, you can choose to get its printed cost from the general supply.
messages.occupations.E146_Reseller.name: Reseller
messages.occupations.E147_AnimalDriver.descriptio: At the start of each harvest, if you have 1/2/3+ fenced <STABLE>, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E147_AnimalDriver.name: Animal Driver
messages.occupations.E148_Lazybones.description: Place (up to) 1 <STABLE> each on __space:grain-seeds|Grain Seeds__, __space:farmland|Farmland__, __space:day-laborer|Day Laborer__, and __space:farm-expansion|Farm Expansion__. Build the <STABLE> at no cost when another player uses that action space.
messages.occupations.E148_Lazybones.name: Lazybones
messages.occupations.E149_MidnightFencer.descript: At the start of the last harvest, you can take up to 2 of each other player's unbuilt <FENCE> and build them on your farm at no cost. (Your farm can then have over 15 <FENCE>.)
messages.occupations.E149_MidnightFencer.name: Midnight Fencer
messages.occupations.E150_RockBeater.description: You can use an action space providing both <STONE> and a different building resource even if it is occupied by another player. Stone rooms cost you 2 <STONE> less each.
messages.occupations.E150_RockBeater.name: Rock Beater
messages.occupations.E151_DeliveryNurse.descripti: Once this game, if you have all types of animals, you can use any __space:wish-children,urgent-wish-children,modest-wish-children-56|Wish for Children__ action space even without room.
messages.occupations.E151_DeliveryNurse.name: Delivery Nurse
messages.occupations.E152_BargainHunter.descripti: At the start of each round, you can place 1 <FOOD> from your supply on the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ accumulation space to play a minor improvement by paying its cost.
messages.occupations.E152_BargainHunter.name: Bargain Hunter
messages.occupations.E153_StoneSculptor.descripti: Each harvest, you can use this card to exchange exactly 1 <STONE> for 1 bonus <SCORE> and 1 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E153_StoneSculptor.name: Stone Sculptor
messages.occupations.E154_Margrave.description: Once you live in a stone house, you get 2 <FOOD> each time any player renovates and, during scoring, 1 bonus <SCORE> for each wood house and clay house.
messages.occupations.E154_Margrave.name: Margrave
messages.occupations.E155_Visionary.description: If you play this card in round 4 or before, you get 1 <STONE>, 1 <VEGETABLE>, and 2 <PIG>. You cannot grow your family until round 11, unless all other players already have.
messages.occupations.E155_Visionary.name: Visionary
messages.occupations.E156_ClaypitOwner.descriptio: Each time another player plays or builds an improvement with a printed <CLAY> cost, you get 1 <FOOD> and 1 <CLAY>.
messages.occupations.E156_ClaypitOwner.name: Claypit Owner
messages.occupations.E157_Usufructuary.descriptio: When you play this card as your first occupation, you immediately get 1 <FOOD> for every other occupation in play (by any player), up to a maximum of 7 <FOOD>.
messages.occupations.E157_Usufructuary.name: Usufructuary
messages.occupations.E158_StoneCustodian.descript: At the end of each work phase, you get 1 <FOOD> for each <STONE> accumulation space with <STONE> on it.
messages.occupations.E158_StoneCustodian.name: Stone Custodian
messages.occupations.E159_OldMiser.description: In the feeding phase of each harvest, each of your people requires 1 less <FOOD>. During scoring, your people are worth 2 points each instead of 3.
messages.occupations.E159_OldMiser.name: Old Miser
messages.occupations.E160_KelpGatherer.descriptio: Each time another player uses the __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation space, they get 1 additional <FOOD> and you get 1 <VEGETABLE>.
messages.occupations.E160_KelpGatherer.name: Kelp Gatherer
messages.occupations.E161_ElderBaker.description: This card is an action space for you only. When you use it, you get 3 <GRAIN>. You can build the __Stone Oven__ major improvement even when taking a __Minor Improvement__ action.
messages.occupations.E161_ElderBaker.name: Elder Baker
messages.occupations.E162_Entrepreneur.descriptio: At the start of each round, you can move 1 <FOOD> to this card or discard 1 <FOOD> from it. If you do either, you get 1 building resource of a type you currently do not have.
messages.occupations.E162_Entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
messages.occupations.E163_Patroness.description: Each time after you play an occupation after this one, you get 1 building resource of your choice.
messages.occupations.E163_Patroness.name: Patroness
messages.occupations.E164_MountainPlowman.descrip: Each time you plow at least 1 <FIELD>, you get 1 <SHEEP> for each <FIELD> that you just plowed.
messages.occupations.E164_MountainPlowman.name: Mountain Plowman
messages.occupations.E165_MasterHuntsman.descript: When you play this card and each time you build a major improvement, you get 1 <PIG>.
messages.occupations.E165_MasterHuntsman.name: Master Huntsman
messages.occupations.E166_Roastmaster.description: Each time you use the __space:traveling-players,traveling-players-56|Traveling Players__ or __space:fishing|Fishing__ accumulation spaces, you can move exactly 1 <FOOD> from that space to the other to get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E166_Roastmaster.name: Roastmaster
messages.occupations.E167_DairyCrier.description: When you play this card, each player (including you) can choose to get 2 <SHEEP> or 2 <FOOD>; you also get 1 <CATTLE>.
messages.occupations.E167_DairyCrier.name: Dairy Crier
At the start of each round, you get 1 <SHEEP>/<PIG>/<CATTLE> for each unoccupied <WOOD>/<CLAY>/stone room in your house.
messages.occupations.OLD_BI14_LinenWeaver.descrip: 每回合开始时，将此卡传给下家，该回合视作他已打出的职业卡。拥有此卡的玩家打出发展卡时可以少花费1木。如果你是最先打出此卡的玩家，则改为木头、砖头、芦苇、石头均少花费1个。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI14_LinenWeaver.name: 亚麻城织布工
messages.occupations.OLD_BI15_Vampire.description: 此卡只能在你的上家刚使用完积累行动格，接着轮到你的轮次时打出。你立即执行相同的行动并从游戏供应区获得该格被使用前的资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI15_Vampire.name: 吸血鬼
messages.occupations.OLD_BI16_InstituteFounder.de: 打出此卡时，你可以支付1份食物购买1份小麦。每次丰收时节的喂养阶段，你的第4、5位家庭成员每位只需要吃1食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI17_WhiteBrazilian.desc: 你只能在你农场上方的一排5格都未被使用时打出此卡。在这排最左边1格和最右边1格分别放1个马厩和1只猪。你有3次机会用手指弹那只野猪。如果弹进了马厩那格(局部进入即可)，你保留马厩和野猪。否则只留下马厩。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI17_WhiteBrazilian.name: 足球射手
messages.occupations.OLD_BI18_AppleMan.descriptio: 每个回家阶段，你可以支付1份蔬菜来执行一次“犁田”、“围栅栏”或“建造马厩”行动，而不需要派遣家庭成员。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI18_AppleMan.name: 苹果农夫
messages.occupations.OLD_BI19_Deaconess.descripti: 如果你只有两名家庭成员，在第1/2/3/4/5/6个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你获得1/2/3/4/5/6份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI19_Deaconess.name: 女执事
messages.occupations.OLD_BI20_Survivalist.descrip: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以使用此卡将至多4个相异的建筑资源各转换成2食物，若如此做，你必须将1食物放到钓鱼积累行动格上。如果你使用钓鱼积累行动格时打出此卡，不可以发动此效果。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI20_Survivalist.name: 生存主义者
messages.occupations.OLD_BI21_ChiefEditor.descrip: 下一次你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得2分。之后, 你每次使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1分。如果你使用钓鱼积累行动格时打出此卡，不可以立即发动此效果。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI21_ChiefEditor.name: 总编
messages.occupations.OLD_BI22_ProtestSinger.descr: 你的每个农场空格能容纳1只动物，该农场空格视作未使用。这些动物不能以任何方式参与繁殖，可以转换为食物，可以移入你农场中其他位置。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI22_ProtestSinger.name: 抗争歌手
messages.occupations.OLD_BI23_SystemsTheorist.des: 每当你建造至少1个马厩时，额外获得1份食物。（同时建造多个马厩只能获得1份食物）游戏结束时, 若你有2/3/4个马厩两两相邻（包括对角相邻）,额外获得1/2/3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_BI24_MemberofaCooperativ: 每当其他玩家执行“生娃”行动时，你从游戏供应区拿取1食物放在此卡上。限1次：在3/4/5位玩家的游戏中，你可以支付此卡上的3/4/5份食物将生儿育女行动格当成求子心切行动格使用。如果其他玩家执行“生娃”行动时，你打出此卡，可立即发动此效果。
messages.occupations.OLD_C01_Governor.description: 从牌库中抽取4张职业卡，并从中选择其中2张加入手牌。如果满足条件，你可以立即免费打出其中1张。
messages.occupations.OLD_C01_Governor.name: 统治者
messages.occupations.OLD_C02_WeekendWorker.descri: 每当你执行“翻修”行动后，你可以扩建1间房屋，费用为1芦苇+1个翻修前房屋等级对应的建筑资源+2个翻修后房屋等级对应的建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_C02_WeekendWorker.name: 周末工作者
messages.occupations.OLD_C03_JackOfAllTrades.desc: 打出此卡后，你弃掉你的所有已打出的职业卡。每个回合开始时，你可以选择一张其他玩家打出的职业卡并支付给他1食物，该回合结束前你拥有该职业卡的效果。(不包含"打出此卡"和"游戏结束"的效果)之后如果你打出新的职业卡，你必须弃掉此卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_C03_JackOfAllTrades.name: 万能博士
messages.occupations.OLD_C04_TeacherOfNations.des: 所有玩家打出每张职业卡的技能培训费都可以少花费1食物。每当其他玩家如此做，你获得1食物。职业卡额外的花费不会减少。比如：K291情圣。
messages.occupations.OLD_C05_Hero.description: 打出此卡时，你立即获得3食物。限1次：你可以弃掉1只猪无需放置家庭成员执行1次“生娃(需要空房间)”行动。新生儿本回合不能行动。
messages.occupations.OLD_C05_Hero.name: 英雄
messages.occupations.OLD_C06_FortuneTeller.descri: 打出此卡时，你获得1个石头。你可以立即观看之后3个未翻开的回合行动卡，并以任意顺序放回而无需按季节要求。你可以随时观看下一张未翻开的回合行动卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_C06_FortuneTeller.name: 预言家
messages.occupations.OLD_C07_Bureaucrat.descripti: 打出此卡时，从个人供应区放置3份食物到此卡上。（这3食物可以随时移入个人供应区）每回合限1次：你可以支付此卡上的1份食物来使用1个仅被一位家庭成员占用的行动格。（即使此家庭成员是属于你自己）新生儿是否是1位家庭成员
messages.occupations.OLD_C07_Bureaucrat.name: 官僚
messages.occupations.OLD_C08_Bagpiper.description: 打出此卡时，你获得2份食物。打出此卡的家庭成员立刻回家并视为未派遣，你可以在之后的轮次中继续派遣他。（如果该职业卡通过行动格打出，则该行动格视为未占据）
messages.occupations.OLD_C08_Bagpiper.name: 风笛手
messages.occupations.OLD_C09_OnlyChild.descriptio: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3根木头。游戏结束时，如果你恰好有3名家庭成员，则你获得3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_C09_OnlyChild.name: 独生子女
messages.occupations.OLD_C10_Informer.description: 打出此卡时，翻面1张你已打出的职业卡，获得5食物/1头牛。该职业卡失效但算作1张职业卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_C10_Informer.name: 告密者
messages.occupations.OLD_C11_Robber.description: 每回合限1次：在其他玩家还有家庭成员未派遣时，你可以跳过你的1次家庭成员派遣获得1木头/1食物。你仍可在后续的轮次中派遣这个家庭成员。
messages.occupations.OLD_C11_Robber.name: 强盗
messages.occupations.OLD_C12_Nicholas.description: 打出此卡时，获得等同于全体玩家家庭成员孩子数量的食物，且不多于6份(孩子指通过"生娃"行动增加的家庭成员)，此外孩子最少的玩家们都可以获得1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_C12_Nicholas.name: 大主教
messages.occupations.OLD_E147_LandAgent.descripti: 打出此卡时，你获得1份蔬菜。每当你使用蔬菜种子行动格时，额外获得1份小麦。
messages.occupations.OLD_E147_LandAgent.name: 地皮商
messages.occupations.OLD_E148_Academic.descriptio: 此卡对次要发展卡和职业卡(例：E217地方官)的需求、功能、数量和计分来说，算作2个职业，1张职业卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_E148_Academic.name: 智者
messages.occupations.OLD_E149_MasterBaker.descrip: 每当有其他玩家执行"烤面包"行动时，如果你有<BAKE>符号发展卡，你获得1次"烤面包"行动。如果你自己执行了1次"烤面包"行动（没有使用此卡），你额外获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E149_MasterBaker.name: 高级烘焙师
messages.occupations.OLD_E150_Baker.description: 打出此卡时，以及每个丰收时节的喂养阶段开始时，你都可以获得1次“烤面包”行动。
messages.occupations.OLD_E150_Baker.name: 烘焙师
messages.occupations.OLD_E151_MasterBuilder.descr: 限1次：一旦你拥有不少于5间房屋，你可以随时再免费扩建1间房屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_E151_MasterBuilder.name: 建筑大师
messages.occupations.OLD_E152_BerryPicker.descrip: 每当你从行动格上获得木头时，你额外获得1份食物。（通过卡牌获得的木头不算）
messages.occupations.OLD_E152_BerryPicker.name: 采莓工
messages.occupations.OLD_E153_Mendicant.descripti: 游戏结束时，你可以弃掉至多2张乞讨卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_E153_Mendicant.name: 乞丐
messages.occupations.OLD_E154_MasterBrewer.descri: 在每个丰收时节的喂养阶段时，你可用此卡将至多1份小麦转化成3份食物。（这不算作“烤面包”行动）
messages.occupations.OLD_E154_MasterBrewer.name: 家庭酿酒师
messages.occupations.OLD_E155_BreadSeller.descrip: 每当任意玩家（包括你自己）执行“烤面包”行动时，每份被转化的小麦都使你额外获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E155_BreadSeller.name: 面包贩
messages.occupations.OLD_E156_BrushMaker.descript: 每当你将猪转换成食物，就把转化的猪放在此卡上。游戏结束时，如果此卡上有2/3/4+头猪，额外获得1/2/3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E156_BrushMaker.name: 制刷工
messages.occupations.OLD_E157_Thatcher.descriptio: 扩建每间房屋、翻修房屋和打出以下发展卡所需费用都减少1捆芦苇。E21半木梁房、I71度假屋、I84鸡舍、I86谷仓、I103水磨坊、K144豪宅。
messages.occupations.OLD_E157_Thatcher.name: 盖顶工
messages.occupations.OLD_E158_Turner.description: 任意时刻，你可以将1个木头转化成1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E158_Turner.name: 车工
messages.occupations.OLD_E159_HeadoftheFamily.des: 即使已有其他玩家占据了能够提供“扩建房屋”和“增加家庭成员”行动的行动格，你仍可使用这些行动格。
messages.occupations.OLD_E160_Farmer.description: 下次你围建至少1根栅栏时，获得1只猪。在此之后，你每次围建至少1根栅栏时，获得1头牛。动物可以立即被转换成食物，即使你没有饲养空间。
messages.occupations.OLD_E160_Farmer.name: 农民
messages.occupations.OLD_E161_Fisherman.descripti: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以获得等于该行动格两倍数量的食物。然后你要付给E12鱼竿、E22木筏、E30独木舟 、I95鱼篓、K126渔网的玩家各1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E161_Fisherman.name: 渔夫
messages.occupations.OLD_E162_MeatSeller.descript: 如果你拥有烤炉，你可以随时将动物转换成食物。每只羊2食物，每头猪3食物，每头牛4食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E162_MeatSeller.name: 售肉商
messages.occupations.OLD_E163_FieldWarden.descrip: 即使已有其他玩家占据了蔬菜种子/犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格，你仍可使用它们。
messages.occupations.OLD_E163_FieldWarden.name: 护田人
messages.occupations.OLD_E164_MasterForester.desc: 本卡将作为额外的树林行动格3人游戏中[2木积累行动格]。从下回合开始，每回合将积累2个木头放在此卡上。其他玩家使用此行动格前，必须先付给你2份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E164_MasterForester.name: 林场主
messages.occupations.OLD_E165_YeomanFarmer.descri: 游戏结束时，你只因为未使用的农场空格和乞讨卡而损失分数。
messages.occupations.OLD_E165_YeomanFarmer.name: 自由农民
messages.occupations.OLD_E166_Undergardener.descr: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，额外获得1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_E166_Undergardener.name: 花园工人
messages.occupations.OLD_E167_Conjurer.descriptio: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，额外获得1份小麦。
messages.occupations.OLD_E167_Conjurer.name: 杂耍艺人
messages.occupations.OLD_E168_Greengrocer.descrip: 每当你使用小麦种子行动格时，额外获得1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_E168_Greengrocer.name: 蔬菜商
messages.occupations.OLD_E169_Storyteller.descrip: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，你可以留下1份食物在卖艺积累行动格，并获得1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_E169_Storyteller.name: 说书人
messages.occupations.OLD_E170_EstateManager.descr: 游戏结束时，如果你三种动物都是数量最多（或者同时最多）的，在3/4/5+人游戏中额外获得2/3/4分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E170_EstateManager.name: 地产管理人
messages.occupations.OLD_E171_DockWorker.descript: 任意时刻，你可以将3根木头转化为1砖/1芦苇/1石头，或者将2砖/2芦苇/2石头转化为1个其他建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_E171_DockWorker.name: 码头工人
messages.occupations.OLD_E172_Chief.description: 打出此卡时，额外支付2份食物。游戏结束时，你的每间石屋都额外获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E172_Chief.name: 酋长
messages.occupations.OLD_E173_ChiefsDaughter.desc: 当其他玩家打出了E172酋长，你可以立即免费打出此卡。游戏结束时，若你的房屋等级是砖屋/石屋，额外获得1/3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E173_ChiefsDaughter.name: 酋长女儿
messages.occupations.OLD_E174_Tutor.description: 游戏结束时，你在此卡之后打出的每个职业都能使你获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E174_Tutor.name: 家庭教师
messages.occupations.OLD_E175_HedgeKeeper.descrip: 每当你建造了至少1根栅栏时，可以额外免费建造3根栅栏。
messages.occupations.OLD_E175_HedgeKeeper.name: 篱笆护理员
messages.occupations.OLD_E176_Woodcutter.descript: 每当你从行动格上获得木头时，额外获得1根木头。（通过卡牌获得的木头不算）
messages.occupations.OLD_E176_Woodcutter.name: 伐木工
messages.occupations.OLD_E177_WoodenHutBuilder.de: 游戏结束时，你所拥有的每间木屋都额外获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E178_HutBuilder.descript: 若你在第1-4回合打出此卡，第11回合开始时，你的房屋等级是木屋/砖屋，则你可以免费扩建 1间房屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_E178_HutBuilder.name: 小屋建造工
messages.occupations.OLD_E179_Merchant.descriptio: 每当你执行“打出主发或次发”或“打出次发”行动后，你可以支付1份食物来将该行动再执行一次。
messages.occupations.OLD_E179_Merchant.name: 商人
messages.occupations.OLD_E180_HobbyFarmer.descrip: 打出此卡时，你获得1份蔬菜。并且你获得1次播种行动，但此次播种行动你只能播种这份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_E180_HobbyFarmer.name: 小园主
messages.occupations.OLD_E181_Cook.description: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你的第3、4、5个家庭成员各只需喂养1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E181_Cook.name: 厨师
messages.occupations.OLD_E182_CharcoalBurner.desc: 每当任意玩家（包括你自己）打出带有 图标的发展卡时，你便获得1根木头+1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E182_CharcoalBurner.name: 烧炭工
messages.occupations.OLD_E183_Basketmaker.descrip: 每个丰收时节，你可以将至多1捆芦苇转化为3份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E183_Basketmaker.name: 编筐工
messages.occupations.OLD_E184_Grocer.description: 从上到下将<REED><GRAIN><STONE><VEGETABLE><WOOD><CLAY><REED><VEGETABLE>排列于此卡上。任意时刻，你可以支付1<FOOD>来买走最上方的物品。
messages.occupations.OLD_E184_Grocer.name: 杂货商
messages.occupations.OLD_E185_ClayFirer.descripti: 任意时刻，你可以把砖头按照以下比例转化成石头：2砖头 → 1石头3砖头 → 2石头
messages.occupations.OLD_E185_ClayFirer.name: 烧砖工
messages.occupations.OLD_E186_ClaySeller.descript: 任意时刻，你可以把砖头转化成以下物品：2砖头 → 1羊/1芦苇3砖头 → 1猪/1石头4砖头 → 1牛动物可以立即被转换成食物，即使你没有饲养空间。
messages.occupations.OLD_E186_ClaySeller.name: 售土商
messages.occupations.OLD_E187_ClayDeliveryman.des: 在第6至14回合中尚未进行的回合行动格上各放置1个砖头。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的砖头。
messages.occupations.OLD_E188_ClayMixer.descripti: 每当你从行动格上只获得了砖头时，额外获得2个砖头。（通过卡牌获得的砖头不算）
messages.occupations.OLD_E188_ClayMixer.name: 和泥匠
messages.occupations.OLD_E189_LordoftheManor.desc: 游戏结束时，你每个获得了4分满分的计分项（包括4个被栅栏围住的马厩）都使你额外获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E189_LordoftheManor.name: 庄园领主
messages.occupations.OLD_E190_Maid.description: 限一次：一旦你的房屋等级是砖屋/石屋，在之后每回合的行动格上各放1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E190_Maid.name: 女仆
messages.occupations.OLD_E191_Mason.description: 放置1个石屋在此卡上。一旦你拥有了不少于4间石屋，你便可随时免费扩建此卡上的这间石屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_E191_Mason.name: 泥水匠
messages.occupations.OLD_E192_Patron.description: 每当你打出1张职业卡前，你先获得2份食物。（在支付技能培训费之前）
messages.occupations.OLD_E192_Patron.name: 赞助商
messages.occupations.OLD_E193_Pastor.description: 限1次：打出此卡时，或在之后的游戏中，一旦你是场上唯一1名仅有2间房屋的玩家，你立即获得3根木头+2块砖头+1捆芦苇+1块石头。WM075移除木屋板块可立即获得资源，然后可使用此卡的资源围建WM075栅栏
messages.occupations.OLD_E193_Pastor.name: 牧师
messages.occupations.OLD_E194_PloughDriver.descri: 一旦你的房屋等级是石屋，你可以在每回合开始时支付1份食物来犁1块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_E194_PloughDriver.name: 驭犁者
messages.occupations.OLD_E195_PloughMaker.descrip: 每当你使用犁田/粮食耕种[犁播]行动格时，你可以花费1份食物额外犁1块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_E195_PloughMaker.name: 制犁工
messages.occupations.OLD_E196_MushroomCollector.d: 每当你使用木头积累行动格后，你可以立即将1根木头转换成2份食物。若你如此做，将那根木头放在你所使用的积累行动格上。
messages.occupations.OLD_E197_Braggart.descriptio: 游戏结束时，若你场上拥有5/6/7/8/9+张发展卡，则你可获得1/3/5/7/9分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E197_Braggart.name: 吹牛大王
messages.occupations.OLD_E198_Ratcatcher.descript: 此卡只能在第九回合结束前打出。在第10和第12回合，所有其他玩家必须少派遣1名家庭成员的后代。(指第3、4、5名家庭成员)
messages.occupations.OLD_E198_Ratcatcher.name: 捕鼠人
messages.occupations.OLD_E199_Renovator.descripti: 你翻修成砖屋/石屋的费用减少2砖头/2石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_E199_Renovator.name: 装修工
messages.occupations.OLD_E200_Conservator.descrip: 在翻修房屋时，你可以跳过砖屋，直接将木屋翻修成石屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_E200_Conservator.name: 建筑复原师
messages.occupations.OLD_E201_CattleWhisperer.des: 将当前回合数加5和9，在这些回合的行动格上各放1头牛。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的牛。
messages.occupations.OLD_E202_SeasonalWorker.desc: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，你额外获得1份小麦。第6回合起，改为额外获得1份小麦/1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_E202_SeasonalWorker.name: 季节工
messages.occupations.OLD_E203_Shepherd.descriptio: 每个繁殖阶段，如果你有至少4只羊，你能繁殖2只羊而不是1只。
messages.occupations.OLD_E203_Shepherd.name: 牧羊人
messages.occupations.OLD_E204_MasterShepherd.desc: 在之后3个回合行动格上各放1只羊。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的羊。
messages.occupations.OLD_E204_MasterShepherd.name: 牧羊人管理员
messages.occupations.OLD_E205_ReedCollector.descr: 打出此卡时，在之后的4个回合行动格上各放1捆芦苇。这些回合开始时，你获得对应的芦苇。
messages.occupations.OLD_E205_ReedCollector.name: 打苇人
messages.occupations.OLD_E206_Swineherd.descripti: 每当你使用猪市场积累行动格时，你额外获得1头猪。
messages.occupations.OLD_E206_Swineherd.name: 猪倌
messages.occupations.OLD_E207_Stablehand.descript: 每轮次限1次：每当你建造至少1根栅栏，你便可以免费建造1个马厩。
messages.occupations.OLD_E207_Stablehand.name: 马厩帮工
messages.occupations.OLD_E208_Stablemaster.descri: 你可在至多1个未被栅栏围住的马厩里饲养3只同种类型的动物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E208_Stablemaster.name: 马厩管理员
messages.occupations.OLD_E209_Quarryman.descripti: 任意时刻，你可以将1个石头转化为2份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E209_Quarryman.name: 采石工
messages.occupations.OLD_E210_StoneCarrier.descri: 每当你从行动格上获得石头时，你额外获得1个石头。如果你同时获得了其他种类的建筑资源，你需要支付1份食物。（通过卡牌获得的石头不算）
messages.occupations.OLD_E210_StoneCarrier.name: 运石工
messages.occupations.OLD_E211_Stonecutter.descrip: 打发展卡、建造房屋和翻修房屋所需的石头费用于你而言总是减少1。
messages.occupations.OLD_E211_Stonecutter.name: 切石工
messages.occupations.OLD_E212_Dancer.description: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，你获得至少4份食物。如果你需要在卖艺格上留下食物，则留下食物后仍获得4份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E212_Dancer.name: 舞者
messages.occupations.OLD_E213_Stockman.descriptio: 打出此卡后，每当你建造了第2/3/4个马厩时，你立即获得1头牛/1头猪/1只羊。动物可以立即被转换成食物，即使你没有饲养空间。
messages.occupations.OLD_E213_Stockman.name: 牲畜饲养员
messages.occupations.OLD_E214_Potter.description: 每个丰收时节，你可以将至多1块砖头转化为2份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_E214_Potter.name: 制陶工
messages.occupations.OLD_E215_TenantFarmer.descri: 你立即获得3种动物各1只。计分阶段开始前，你必须退还3种动物各1只，否则每只不退还的动物使你-1分。动物可以立即被转换成食物，即使你没有饲养空间。
messages.occupations.OLD_E215_TenantFarmer.name: 动物租用人
messages.occupations.OLD_E216_AnimalKeeper.descri: 你的每个圈地可以饲养不同种类的动物。(K145林间牧场除外)
messages.occupations.OLD_E216_AnimalKeeper.name: 动物管理员
messages.occupations.OLD_E217_Reeve.description: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4根木头。游戏结束时，打出职业最多的玩家都额外获得3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_E217_Reeve.name: 地方官
messages.occupations.OLD_E218_Carpenter.descripti: 你扩建每间房屋只需花费2捆芦苇和3份对应你房屋类型的建材。例如：扩建1间石屋只需2捆芦苇+3个石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_E218_Carpenter.name: 木匠
messages.occupations.OLD_E29_ShepherdsPipe.descri: 每个饲养羊的圈地可以额外饲养2只羊，每个圈地外的马厩可以饲养2只羊。
messages.occupations.OLD_E29_ShepherdsPipe.name: 兽角笛
messages.occupations.OLD_E341_Guildmaster.descrip: 打出此卡后，每当你打出I258家具匠/A7家具工坊、E214制陶工/A8陶艺工坊、E183编筐工/A9编筐工坊时，你对应获得4木、4砖、3芦苇。若打出此卡时，你已拥有上述某卡，对于每张卡，你获得对应的2个资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_E341_Guildmaster.name: 公会主席
messages.occupations.OLD_FL031_OldMaster.descript: 第3至7回合的工作阶段开始时，你获得1根木头。如果森林[3木]积累行动格上有至少6根木头，则改为获得1个石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL031_OldMaster.name: 绘画大师
messages.occupations.OLD_FL032_Elder.description: 打出此卡时，从游戏供应区拿取2份食物放在此卡上，你可以随时使用此卡上的食物。每个工作阶段结束时，你可以支付此卡上的1份食物来使用钓鱼积累行动格或执行"烤面包"行动无需派遣家庭成员。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL032_Elder.name: 长者
messages.occupations.OLD_FL033_Sculptor.descripti: 每当你从积累行动格上只获得了砖头和/或石头时，你额外获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL033_Sculptor.name: 雕刻家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL034_FranciscanMonk.des: 打出此卡时，获得1份小麦，并且可以弃掉1张乞讨卡。任意时刻，你可以弃掉手牌中的1张次要发展卡，然后从牌库中随机抽取1张职业卡加入手牌。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL035_Freemason.descript: 只要你居住在仅有2个房间的砖屋/石屋内，在每回合的工作阶段开始时，你获得2块砖头/石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL035_Freemason.name: 共济会员
messages.occupations.OLD_FL036_VegetableSeller.de: 你可以随时从游戏供应区借用1份蔬菜。任意时刻，你可以将个人供应区的1份蔬菜转化为2份食物。计分阶段前，你必须退还借用的蔬菜，每少退还1份蔬菜，领取1张乞讨卡。注：此卡若以任意方式退还或翻面，你仍需要退还借用的蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL037_RoughBaker.descrip: 打出此卡时，你获得1份小麦和1次“烤面包”行动。你的砖造烤炉可以当成石造烤炉使用，你的石造烤炉可以当成砖造烤炉使用。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL037_RoughBaker.name: 粗鲁的烘焙师
此卡是只有你能使用的行动格。使用此格时，你获得等同于你羊数量的羊，但不能超过你未使用的空格数。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL039_Cosmographer.descr: 打出此卡时，从游戏供应区拿取1芦苇+1石头放到你农场的两个空格上，空格仍视作未使用。你可以随时将其移入个人供应区。游戏结束时，如果芦苇与羊在同一圈地或同一格子上、石头与猪在同一圈地或同一格子上，则各使你获得2分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL039_Cosmographer.name: 宇宙学家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL040_Anatomist.descript: 在未翻开的第7、10和13回合行动格上各放置1个食客标记。这些回合开始时，你获得这个食客，你必须在当回合的最后一个轮次派遣该食客，且只能派遣到积累行动格上。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL040_Anatomist.name: 解剖学家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL041_FryCook.descriptio: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你的两名成年家庭成员都少支付1份食物，其他每位成年家庭成员多支付1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL041_FryCook.name: 油炸厨师
messages.occupations.OLD_FL042_Rainmaker.descript: 每当你打出1张发展卡时，你可以在1块已播种的田上放置至多1个对应作物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL042_Rainmaker.name: 成功企业家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL043_RubenesqueWoman.de: 每回合，当你派遣你的第2名家庭成员去使用一个积累行动格时，你额外获得1份对应资源。每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你必须额外支付1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL044_Returnee.descripti: 每个工作阶段结束时，在你最后使用的行动格上从游戏供应区放置1份小麦。下一回合，如果你使用该行动格，你首先获得这份小麦，否则弃掉此小麦。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL044_Returnee.name: 海归
messages.occupations.OLD_FL045_SchoolDropout.desc: 每回合的工作阶段中，如果你执行了“生娃”行动，而且之后其他家庭成员没有使用1至14回合行动格，在当回合，你可以派遣你新增的家庭成员执行行动（此时可以执行1-14回合行动格）且不算作“新生儿”。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL045_SchoolDropout.name: 辍学者
messages.occupations.OLD_FL046_StableArchitect.de: 游戏结束时，你农场上每个未被栅栏围住的马厩都能使你获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL047_FarmLawyer.descrip: 打出此卡时，选择一名食物数量比你多的玩家，你获得你们食物数量差值的食物，然后将此卡加入该玩家的手牌。从牌库中抽取一张职业牌正面朝下放在你面前表示1张已打出的职业卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL047_FarmLawyer.name: 彼得·勃鲁盖尔
messages.occupations.OLD_FL048_Botanist.descripti: 每当其他玩家从木头积累行动格获得恰好3根木头时，你获得1份食物。（不包括卡牌获得的木头，或者留下的木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL048_Botanist.name: 植物学家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL049_Accountant.descrip: 打出此卡时，在3/4/5人游戏中，立即获得2/1/0根木头。每当其他玩家打出职业卡时，从游戏供应区拿取1份食物放在此卡上。任意时刻，你可以使用此卡上的食物购买物品：羊/石头每个2食物，猪/小麦每个3食物，牛/蔬菜每个4食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL049_Accountant.name: 会计师
messages.occupations.OLD_FL050_MeatSupplier.descr: 每个丰收时节开始时，你可以将1只猪或1头牛转化为1分，若如此做，所有其他玩家各获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL050_MeatSupplier.name: 肉类供应商
每当你使用本回合新翻开的回合行动格时，你可以获得钓鱼积累行动格上的所有食物。其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时额外获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL052_Scribbler.descript: 每当其他玩家使用临时工行动格时，你和他各额外获得1份食物。每个工作阶段结束时，如果无人使用临时工，从游戏供应区放置1份食物到此卡上，你打职业卡可以花费此卡上的食物(包括情圣花费等)。游戏结束时，此卡上如果有4/6/8/10+份食物，你获得1/2/3/4分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL052_Scribbler.name: 三流作家
messages.occupations.OLD_FL053_CafeSinger.descrip: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，你可以将1只羊转化为1份蔬菜/将1头牛转化为2份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL053_CafeSinger.name: 咖啡厅歌手
messages.occupations.OLD_FL054_ChansonSinger.desc: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，你可以留下1/2/3/4份食物获得1木/1木+1砖/1木+1砖+1芦苇/1木+1砖+1芦苇+1石头
messages.occupations.OLD_FL054_ChansonSinger.name: 法国民谣歌手
messages.occupations.OLD_FL055_Recluse.descriptio: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果存在某一竖列的行动格上只有你的家庭成员，则你获得1份食物。每回合最多获得1食物。(如第12和13回合行动格构成一竖列)
messages.occupations.OLD_FL055_Recluse.name: 隐士
messages.occupations.OLD_FL056_FlemishPatriot.des: 在每个偶数回合，在你派遣完第一名家庭成员使用一个行动格后，你获得1份食物，然后从游戏供应区在与此格同一竖列的未占用的行动格上各放置1份食物，下一个使用这些行动格的玩家获得这份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL057_Chaplain.descripti: 每当其他玩家执行“生娃”行动后，你可以立即派遣1名家庭成员。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL057_Chaplain.name: 随军牧师
messages.occupations.OLD_FL058_GoldWeigher.descri: 每当其他玩家打出至少价值2分的发展卡前，必须先支付你1份食物。注：价值2分指的是画在发展卡上的分数。不包括奖励分数。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL058_GoldWeigher.name: 称金人
messages.occupations.OLD_FL059_PillarBiter.descri: 每当其他玩家围建了至少1根栅栏条时，你可以立即支付2/3根木头来围建3/4根栅栏条。是否恰好注：必须遵守“围建栅栏”的基本规则。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL059_PillarBiter.name: 啃柱子的小孩
messages.occupations.OLD_FL060_VirtuousHero.descr: 每当其他玩家都没有你的栅栏条时，你可以给他们每人1根你供应区的栅栏条。每当其他玩家从积累行动格获得食物之外的物品时，你可以从他那拿回栅栏条，然后你获得1份食物，该玩家获得额外的1个该物品。
messages.occupations.OLD_FL060_VirtuousHero.name: 德高望重的英雄
messages.occupations.OLD_FR061_Agrarian.descripti: 每回合开始时，你可以支付1份食物放置到犁田行动格，使用此格的玩家获得这份食物。本回合结束时，如果本回合没人使用此格，则你可以拿回这份食物并犁1块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR061_Agrarian.name: 土地改革者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR062_AnimalWelfarist.de: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果你本回合在行动格上执行了“建造马厩”行动，并且在建造圈地行动格上执行了“围建栅栏”行动，则你获得羊、猪、牛每种动物各1只。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR063_ArtDirector.descri: 每当你使用卖艺积累行动格时，你额外获得1份食物+1个任意建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR063_ArtDirector.name: 艺术总监
messages.occupations.OLD_FR064_AwardWinner.descri: 每回合限1次：每当你打出发展卡时，你可以额外支付任意1个所需支付的建筑资源，然后额外获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR064_AwardWinner.name: 大奖得主
messages.occupations.OLD_FR065_Benefactor.descrip: 限1次：如果你有4个圈地，则你可以支付1只动物来免费扩建1间木屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR065_Benefactor.name: 施主
messages.occupations.OLD_FR066_Boatswain.descript: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以在你的每块空田上(包括卡牌田)各放置1份小麦(这不算作“播种”行动)。这些田视为已播种的麦田。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR066_Boatswain.name: 水手长
messages.occupations.OLD_FR067_CabbageLover.descr: 打出此卡时，获得1份蔬菜。你每将1份蔬菜转化为食物，可以支付1块砖头到此卡上，游戏结束时，此卡上的每1个砖头使你获得1分，至多5分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR067_CabbageLover.name: 白菜爱好者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR068_CardPlayer.descrip: 打出此卡时，从游戏供应区按右图所示拿取物品排列于此卡上。每回合结束时，将最上面的资源移到最下面。每当你获得此卡最上面/最下面的资源时，你额外获得1个/退还1个到游戏供应区。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR068_CardPlayer.name: 卡牌玩家
messages.occupations.OLD_FR069_CatLover.descripti: 如果你有至少1/2/4/7只动物(卡牌动物不算)，则你扩建的每间木屋花费可减少1/2/3/4个任意建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR069_CatLover.name: 爱猫人
messages.occupations.OLD_FR070_CattleDealer.descr: 每当你围建起一个占据至少3个农场空格的圈地时，你可以支付1捆芦苇获得2头牛。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR070_CattleDealer.name: 牛只贩子
messages.occupations.OLD_FR071_ChildCareWorker.de: 每当其他玩家执行“生娃”行动时，你可以将至多1根木头转化为2份食物，或者将1根木头+1捆芦苇转化为5份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR072_Cocotte.descriptio: 每当你使用临时工行动格时，你可以打出1张次要发展卡，或者支付1份食物打出1张主要发展卡。（正常支付发展卡的费用）
messages.occupations.OLD_FR072_Cocotte.name: 娼妓
messages.occupations.OLD_FR073_ConvictNumber24601: 从下回合开始，你每回合都必须少派遣1名家庭成员。游戏结束时，对于每个打出此卡后的回合(包括打出此卡的这一回合)，你都获得2分。（仍需正常喂养该名家庭成员）
messages.occupations.OLD_FR074_CountryDoctor.desc: 限1次：如果你有3块麦田，你可以将一次“生娃”行动当成“生娃(无需空房间)”行动执行。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR074_CountryDoctor.name: 乡村医生
messages.occupations.OLD_FR075_CowboyAndMother.de: 从第4回合起，每回合工作阶段结束时，如果你有不多于2名家庭成员且本回合使用过不多于2个行动格，则你获得1份食物，从第8/12回合起，可以改为获得1只任意动物/犁1块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR076_DebtCollector.desc: 打出时在当前回合数+3或之后的回合行动格中选择一个放置1个食客标记。该回合开始时，你向当回合的起始玩家支付1份食物并先于他派遣这名食客，然后从起始玩家开始，按照正常顺序派遣家庭成员。本回合结束后，退还该食客。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR076_DebtCollector.name: 讨债人
messages.occupations.OLD_FR077_DoveHunter.descrip: 每个丰收时节的喂养阶段，你可以将至多1只羊转化为4份食物，或将至多1头牛转化为6份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR077_DoveHunter.name: 鸽子猎人
messages.occupations.OLD_FR078_DrawingGenius.desc: 每当你使用当回合新翻开的那张回合行动卡之后，你可以打出1张主要或次要发展卡。（正常支付发展卡的费用）
messages.occupations.OLD_FR078_DrawingGenius.name: 绘图天才
在第7至14回合的行动格上各放置1份食物。这些回合开始时，你获得这份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR080_FencingMaster.desc: 每当你打出1张职业卡(包括此卡)后，将你供应区的至多2根栅栏条放到此卡上。从第4张职业起，改为至多1根。每当你执行“围建栅栏”行动时，你可以免费使用此卡上的栅栏条。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR080_FencingMaster.name: 剑术大师
messages.occupations.OLD_FR081_Fiddler.descriptio: 每回合结束时，如果你在该回合没有获得任何建筑资源，则你获得1根木头。如果是偶数回合，则你还额外获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR081_Fiddler.name: 提琴手
messages.occupations.OLD_FR082_GardeningEnthusias: 打出此卡时，立即获得1份小麦+1份蔬菜。计分阶段前，你必须退还1份小麦+1份蔬菜，每少退还1个你-1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR083_GoodFriend.descrip: 在此卡上放置3木头+2砖+2石头+1芦苇。每当其他玩家支付建筑资源打出次要发展卡时，你可以从此卡上获得至多1个他支付的1种建筑资源。(如果某张主要发展卡被视为次要发展卡打出，也是有效的)
messages.occupations.OLD_FR083_GoodFriend.name: 好朋友
messages.occupations.OLD_FR084_GrainSpeculator.de: 将当前回合数加1，3和5，在这些回合的行动格上各放置1份小麦。这些回合开始时，你获得这份小麦。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR085_Harvester.descript: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4根木头。游戏结束时，在最后一个丰收时节收割了至少5份作物的玩家都额外获得3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR085_Harvester.name: 收割庄稼者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR086_HeadOfTheRevolutio: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4根木头。打出此卡后，下一个填满自己农场所有空格的玩家获得3分。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR087_ImmigrantsSon.desc: 打出此卡后，当你打出你的第5、6、7个职业时，你可以犁一块田。(打出此卡时不能触发)WM070发条人可以触发。E148智者可以犁两块。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR087_ImmigrantsSon.name: 移民者的儿子
messages.occupations.OLD_FR088_Journeyman.descrip: 一旦你的房屋等级是石屋，每回合开始时，你可以支付1份食物购买1只任意动物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR088_Journeyman.name: 熟练工人
打出此卡时，你获得1次“播种”行动。此卡视为2块田。(不参与计分)
messages.occupations.OLD_FR090_LemonTrader.descri: 每回合限2次：你可以支付1份小麦/1份蔬菜获得1/2个不同的建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR090_LemonTrader.name: 柠檬交易商
messages.occupations.OLD_FR091_ManualLabourer.des: 每回合结束时，如果你在该回合获得了恰好1种建筑资源，则你额外获得1个该种建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR092_MartialArtist.desc: 每个丰收时节开始时，你可以弃掉至多2张次发卡，每张使你获得2份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR092_MartialArtist.name: 武术家
messages.occupations.OLD_FR093_Mastermind.descrip: 在打出此卡之后，你每打出1张印有奖励分数标记的卡牌(得分标记不算)，游戏结束时都使你获得1分(此卡下面就有奖励分数标记)。如果退还了该卡牌，仍然算分。下面负分标记也算。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR093_Mastermind.name: 主谋
messages.occupations.OLD_FR094_Miser.description: 每当你通过行动格执行“建造房屋”行动时，如果你恰好扩建了1间木屋/砖屋/石屋，则你少花费1芦苇+1木头/1芦苇+1砖头/1芦苇+1石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR094_Miser.name: 小气鬼
messages.occupations.OLD_FR095_Musketeer.descript: 打出此卡时放置1个箭头指示物到由你选择的4个相邻行动格的交界点。每个工作阶段结束时，如果你占用了这些行动格中的2/3/4个，你获得1只羊/猪/牛。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR095_Musketeer.name: 火枪手
messages.occupations.OLD_FR096_Oceanographer.desc: 按从下到上将蔬菜、石头、小麦、砖排列于此卡上，每当你犁了恰好1块田时，你获得最上面的资源。1次犁了多块田不能触发。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR096_Oceanographer.name: 海洋学家
messages.occupations.OLD_FR097_ParquetSetter.desc: 每个工作阶段结束时，如果在该回合你未使用的空格减少了1/2+格，则你获得1木头/1木头+1食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR097_ParquetSetter.name: 木地板装修工
messages.occupations.OLD_FR098_PasteurizationExpe: 从上到下按照<SHEEP>、<PIG>、<SHEEP>、<CATTLE>物品排列于此卡上，每当你在丰收时节的繁殖阶段外获得与最上面的动物同种的动物时，你获得最上面的动物。一次性获得多个动物，自己选择获得顺序。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR099_PearPeeler.descrip: 每当你从行动格上获得木头时，你可以留下1/2/3根木头而获得1份小麦/1份蔬菜/1份小麦+1份蔬菜。(留下的木头不能多于原来行动格上原来的木头)
messages.occupations.OLD_FR099_PearPeeler.name: 削梨工
messages.occupations.OLD_FR100_PipeSmoker.descrip: 每个丰收时节开始时，如果你有至少1块麦田，你获得2根木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR100_PipeSmoker.name: 烟斗客
messages.occupations.OLD_FR101_Powerhouse.descrip: 每个工作阶段开始时，如果你有至少3/5个石头，则你获得1/2份食物。可以通过WM41先转化石头再发动此效果。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR101_Powerhouse.name: 精力充沛者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR102_Prefect.descriptio: 每个丰收时节，每当任意玩家使用职业卡或发展卡把建筑资源转化为食物时，对于每张被使用的职业卡和次发卡，你获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR102_Prefect.name: 长官
messages.occupations.OLD_FR103_Prosecutor.descrip: 每当你打出发展卡前，如果你打出的发展卡数量比2/3/4位其他玩家少，那么你打出发展卡时可以少支付1/2/3个任意建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR103_Prosecutor.name: 检察官
messages.occupations.OLD_FR104_RacingStableManage: 每次你建造至少1个马厩时，你可以支付1份食物来立即犁1块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR105_Reformer.descripti: 你每张已打出的职业卡可以饲养1只任意动物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR105_Reformer.name: 改革家
messages.occupations.OLD_FR106_SailboatConstructo: 在此卡上放置4组资源：3木、3砖、2石头、1小麦+1蔬菜。每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你可以购买此卡上的任意组资源，第1/2/3/4组你购买的资源花费2/3/4/5份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR107_SculptorsSon.descr: 如果你拥有A7家具工坊/K122大家具工坊、A8陶艺工坊/WM086大陶艺工坊、A9编筐工坊/FR041大编筐工坊，则每当你派遣家庭成员只从行动格上获得木头/砖头/芦苇时，你额外获得2木头/2砖头/1芦苇。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR107_SculptorsSon.name: 雕刻家之子
messages.occupations.OLD_FR108_ShovelWorker.descr: 在每个丰收时节的收割阶段，如果你有至少2/3/4/5个圈地，则你获得1/2/3/4份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR108_ShovelWorker.name: 铲土工
messages.occupations.OLD_FR109_StageStar.descript: 如果你在第一季打出此卡，你立即获得6根木头。每当其他玩家使用卖艺积累行动格时，如果你有至少1根木头，你必须支付他1根木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR109_StageStar.name: 舞台之星
messages.occupations.OLD_FR110_Stroller.descripti: 打出此卡时，在此卡上从上至下以任意顺序放置6个由你选择的建筑资源，且必须包含各种建筑资源。每个丰收时节的收割阶段，你获得此卡最上面的资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR110_Stroller.name: 流浪者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR111_SunFarmer.descript: 每当你使用小麦种子行动格时，你额外获得1只羊。每当你使用羊市场积累行动格时，你额外获得1份小麦。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR111_SunFarmer.name: 太阳农夫
messages.occupations.OLD_FR112_TowerBuilder.descr: 如果你是场上唯一只有2间房屋的玩家，则当你通过行动格上的“建造房屋”行动并建造了至少1间房屋时，你可以额外免费建造1间房屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR112_TowerBuilder.name: 高塔建造师
messages.occupations.OLD_FR113_Trailblazer.descri: 每回合开始时，如果你没有空的田地板块，你可以支付1份食物来犁一块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR113_Trailblazer.name: 开拓者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR114_TurkeyBreeder.desc: 打出此卡时，你可以免费建造至多4根栅栏+1个马厩。最后一个丰收时节结束时，你必须退还4根木头，每少退还1根木头，你必须领取1张乞讨卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR114_TurkeyBreeder.name: 火鸡饲养员
messages.occupations.OLD_FR115_UnicycleDriver.des: 每回合开始时，你可以支付1个石头，用你供应区的1根栅栏条在两个正交相邻的行动格间修建1条“路”。每回合限1次：每个工作阶段结束时，如果你占用了1条“路”的一端而另一端未被占用，你可以移动此家庭成员去使用未被占用的该行动格（可以使用工作阶段结束被占用的行动格）。如果你同时打出了WM023森林农夫/G046池塘看守员，可以自己选择。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR116_VillageDruid.descr: 每当你打出1张职业卡后，你获得1只羊。(不包括此卡)
messages.occupations.OLD_FR116_VillageDruid.name: 橡木贤者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR117_WealthiestEuropean: 如果此卡是你打出的第一张职业卡，你立即获得等同于已过完整回合数的任意建筑资源。比如第3回合打出此卡，你获得2个任意建筑资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR118_WoodGatherers.desc: 每回合结束时，如果你在该回合通过打发展卡、扩建房屋、建造马厩、围建栅栏上总计花费了至少4根木头，你获得2根木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR118_WoodGatherers.name: 木头收集者
messages.occupations.OLD_FR119_Workaholic.descrip: 打出此卡时如果你没有动物，放置5木头+4砖头+3石头在此卡上，一旦你拥有至少5/7/9只动物(卡牌动物不算)，你获得此卡上的所有木头/砖头/石头。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR119_Workaholic.name: 工作狂人
messages.occupations.OLD_FR120_WritingManiac.desc: 在第5、7、9和11回合行动格上各倒扣你的1张职业牌，这些回合开始时，你可以支付2份食物打出这张职业卡，否则收回手牌。
messages.occupations.OLD_FR120_WritingManiac.name: 写作狂人
messages.occupations.OLD_G001_AlternativeDesigner: 每当你建造马厩或围建栅栏时，可以用至多2砖头/2石头代替2木头。每当你扩建房屋时，每间房屋资源可以用至多2砖头/2石头代替2木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_G002_AnimalFarmer.descri: 游戏结束时，你每拥有1个达到最大饲养容量的圈地，便额外获得1分。若你所有圈地都达到了最大饲养容量，则你额外再获得1分。卡牌圈地（至少要有1个圈地）
messages.occupations.OLD_G002_AnimalFarmer.name: 完美农夫
messages.occupations.OLD_G003_AnimalHolder.descri: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4根木头。游戏结束时，拥有动物总数最多的玩家们额外获得3分。（卡牌动物不算，公羊计算在内）
messages.occupations.OLD_G003_AnimalHolder.name: 动物饲养员
messages.occupations.OLD_G004_Apprentice.descript: 每次丰收时节开始时，你每拥有一张分数至少2分的主要发展卡(包括其升级版)，可以额外获得1份食物。（若有主要发展卡被你视为次要发展卡，此时仍算作主要发展卡）升级版的主发
messages.occupations.OLD_G004_Apprentice.name: 学徒工
messages.occupations.OLD_G005_Architect.descripti: 打出此卡后，你每建造1间房屋便获得2份食物，你每建造1个马厩便获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G005_Architect.name: 建筑设计师
messages.occupations.OLD_G006_Artisan.description: 每个丰收时节限一次：若你在丰收时节通过发展卡将建筑资源转换为食物，则你额外获得2份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G006_Artisan.name: 手艺人
messages.occupations.OLD_G007_Astronomer.descript: 打出此卡时，立即获得2份食物。每回合返家阶段，若你已行动的家庭成员(包括食客)有3/4/5个占据的行动格纵向/横向相邻构成直线，则你额外获得1/3/5分。这些行动格必须大小相同。
messages.occupations.OLD_G007_Astronomer.name: 天文学家
messages.occupations.OLD_G008_Auctioneer.descript: 在第7、9、11、13回合行动格上各放2芦苇、3木头、3砖头、2石头。回合开始时用食物拍卖(暗标)。出价最高者得到资源，你获得食物。若你出价最高，食物交给公共区。若出价相同，按照本回合行动顺序在前者竞标成功。
messages.occupations.OLD_G008_Auctioneer.name: 拍卖商
messages.occupations.OLD_G009_BakersDaughter.desc: 当其他玩家打出了E149高级烘焙师或E150烘焙师，你可以立即免费打出此卡。打出此卡时，立即获得一次“烤面包”行动。即使已有其他玩家占据了小麦种子/粮食生产[播烤]行动格，你仍可使用它们。
messages.occupations.OLD_G009_BakersDaughter.name: 烘焙师女儿
messages.occupations.OLD_G010_Bard.description: 每当其他玩家使用卖艺积累行动格时，你获得1份食物+1个木头。
messages.occupations.OLD_G010_Bard.name: 琵琶演奏家
messages.occupations.OLD_G011_CarrotCakeBaker.des: 你可以随时将1份蔬菜转化为2份食物。每当你将蔬菜转换为食物时，你获得一次“烤面包”行动。
messages.occupations.OLD_G012_CarrotFarmer.descri: 放置3份蔬菜在此卡上。每当你使用犁田行动格时，可以支付1份食物，获得此卡上的1份蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_G012_CarrotFarmer.name: 胡萝卜种植者
messages.occupations.OLD_G013_ClayStarter.descrip: 打出此卡时，若你处于木屋阶段，且只有2间木屋，则你可以支付1份食物，立即将你的木屋免费翻修成砖屋。
messages.occupations.OLD_G013_ClayStarter.name: 砖屋起家者
messages.occupations.OLD_G014_EarlyRiser.descript: 打出时获得1只羊。每个丰收时节，你首先执行繁殖阶段，此时可以将新出生的动物立即转换为食物（即使农场已无容纳空间），然后再进行收割作物和喂养家庭成员阶段
messages.occupations.OLD_G014_EarlyRiser.name: 早起者
messages.occupations.OLD_G015_FamilyCounselor.des: 每个回合返家阶段开始前，若你所有的成年家庭成员都在同一游戏版图上，你有2/3/4+名成年家庭成员便可以获得1食物/1小麦/1蔬菜。（不包括食客和新生儿）
messages.occupations.OLD_G016_FenceHelper.descrip: 每当其他玩家执行“围建栅栏”行动时，你可以支付他1食物来执行一次“围建栅栏”行动。其他玩家打出K312栅栏监管员和E40迷你圈地有效。
messages.occupations.OLD_G016_FenceHelper.name: 栅栏帮手
messages.occupations.OLD_G017_FishSeller.descript: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以花费该行动格上的食物购买最多2个相同或不同的物品。1食物购买1建筑资源，2食物购买1羊/1猪/1小麦，3食物购买1牛/1蔬菜。
messages.occupations.OLD_G017_FishSeller.name: 卖鱼人
messages.occupations.OLD_G018_FishermansApprentic: 每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你可以向他支付1份食物，并打出1张职业卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_G019_FoodCritic.descript: 下一次你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，从游戏供应区拿取1份食物留在此卡上。每次你烤面包或将动物、蔬菜、建筑资源转化为食物时，将被转换物放在此卡上。游戏结束时，此卡上有4/5/6/7+种不同种物品，你获得1/2/4/6分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G019_FoodCritic.name: 美食评论家
messages.occupations.OLD_G020_Freeloader.descript: 每回合你的第一名家庭成员可以使用任意行动格，即使已有其他玩家占据。你的第一名家庭成员不能使用聚会场所[起始玩家]行动格，即使该行动格无人占据。
messages.occupations.OLD_G020_Freeloader.name: 特权人士
messages.occupations.OLD_G021_Hermit.description: 游戏结束时，若你面前有且仅有这一张职业卡，你获得6分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G021_Hermit.name: 隐士
messages.occupations.OLD_G022_GlassBlower.descrip: 如果你拥有烤炉，每个丰收时节你可以将1/2块砖头转换为3/5份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G022_GlassBlower.name: 玻璃工
messages.occupations.OLD_G023_Glutton.description: 丰每个收时节的家庭成员喂养阶段，你可以额外支付3份食物获得1分。你可以用此卡至多获得6分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G023_Glutton.name: 贪吃鬼
messages.occupations.OLD_G024_Grafter.description: 每个丰收时节的动物繁殖阶段，如果你个人供应区里的小麦/蔬菜数量大于等于2,则你额外获得1份小麦/蔬菜。农田里的作物不参与计算。
messages.occupations.OLD_G024_Grafter.name: 嫁接育种商
messages.occupations.OLD_G025_Businesswoman.descr: 打出此卡时，你可以立即打出至多两张发展卡。(需满足条件并正常支付费用)
messages.occupations.OLD_G025_Businesswoman.name: 女商人
messages.occupations.OLD_G026_GrainFarmer.descrip: 每个丰收时节的作物收获阶段开始前，如果你的农田里（包括卡牌田）有至少1/4/7/10+份小麦，获得1/2/3/4份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G026_GrainFarmer.name: 谷物农夫
messages.occupations.OLD_G027_GrainLover.descript: 如果你在第7回合或之前打出此卡，可以立即犁一块田，并且可以在这块田里播种1份小麦（个人供应区），这算作1次播种行动。游戏结束时，小麦数量最多的玩家额外获得2分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G027_GrainLover.name: 谷物情人
messages.occupations.OLD_G028_Grump.description: 打出此卡时，若距离游戏结束还有1/3/6/9个完整回合，则你立即获得1/2/3/4根木头。游戏结束时，家庭成员最少的玩家额外获得2分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G028_Grump.name: 脾气暴躁者
messages.occupations.OLD_G029_HarborMaster.descri: 每当你使用钓鱼积累行动格时，额外获得1捆芦苇；每当其他玩家使用钓鱼积累行动格时，你获得1捆芦苇+1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G029_HarborMaster.name: 港口管理员
messages.occupations.OLD_G030_Headmaster.descript: 每当其他玩家打出一张职业卡时，你从游戏供应区拿取1食物放在此卡上。当你打出职业卡时，可以使用此卡上的食物。游戏结束时，在4/5+人游戏中，此卡上每有3/4份食物，你便额外获得1分。
messages.occupations.OLD_G030_Headmaster.name: 校长
messages.occupations.OLD_G031_Helper.description: 即使已有其他玩家占据了能提供“翻修”/“扩建房屋”/“打出主要/次要发展卡”行动的行动格，你仍可使用它们。自己占用则不可以第2次使用。
messages.occupations.OLD_G031_Helper.name: 帮工
messages.occupations.OLD_G032_Hobbyist.descriptio: 每当其他玩家打出职业卡时，你可以支付1份食物到公共区，打出一张次要发展卡；或支付2份食物打出一张主要发展卡。
messages.occupations.OLD_G032_Hobbyist.name: 业余爱好者
messages.occupations.OLD_G033_HoeMaker.descriptio: 每当你围建至少1根栅栏时，可以额外支付1份食物，犁一块田。
messages.occupations.OLD_G033_HoeMaker.name: 锄头制造商
messages.occupations.OLD_G034_Inventor.descriptio: 所有费用印有需要花费4个或以上资源的发展卡，当你打出时皆可以少付任意一个资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_G034_Inventor.name: 发明家
messages.occupations.OLD_G035_JobSeeker.descripti: 此卡不算为职业。每回合开始前，若你打出的职业数量少于其他两个玩家，则你可以支付1份食物打出一张职业卡。用该方式打出的职业卡不能收回手中。
messages.occupations.OLD_G035_JobSeeker.name: 求职者
messages.occupations.OLD_G036_LateBloomer.descrip: 任何时候，若你的家庭成员数量少于其他所有玩家，并且你家中有居住空间，则你可以立即获得1名新的家庭成员。此家庭成员不算作“新生儿”，本回合可以被派遣。
messages.occupations.OLD_G036_LateBloomer.name: 中年成家者
messages.occupations.OLD_G037_LateSleeper.descrip: 每回合开始时，你声明你是否“晚睡”。若你声明“晚睡”，则你本回合获得1名食客标记，并且等所有其他玩家的家庭成员全部放置完成后，你方可放置你的家庭成员和食客标记。
messages.occupations.OLD_G037_LateSleeper.name: 晚睡者
messages.occupations.OLD_G038_MasterBakersApprent: 打出此卡时，立即获得1次“烤面包”行动。并且在一个已有的行动格上放置一个标记物，从此该行动格增加了“和/或烤面包”行动。当其他玩家使用此行动格执行“烤面包”行动时，你获得1份食物。
messages.occupations.OLD_G039_Mathematician.descr: 第6回合起，资源补充阶段完成后，如果存在有两个或以上行动格中木头数量相等，则你可以选择其中一个行动格拿取1个木头。砖头同理。在5+人游戏中，石头同理。每回合只能用此方法拿取1个资源。
messages.occupations.OLD_G039_Mathematician.name: 数学家
